title: Implement the campaign navigation shell and scoped routes

body:
Implementation parent: [Militia UI rework](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/148) · Original planning map: [UI rework decisions](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/99) · Authoring task: [Write this area spec](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/123).

When creating implementation tickets from this spec, follow the [source traceability requirements](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/148#source-traceability-and-future-tickets): link back to this spec and carry forward the relevant decision-comment permalinks, amendments, pinned prototypes and capability IDs from the sections below.

## 1. Scope and ownership

Deliver the campaign navigation shell as **rollout position 1 of 12**, with the current live editors working inside it. Players can navigate to a named campaign, its current week, Finished weeks, Militia, Characters & officers and Setup, including from existing bookmarks, without losing campaign context or any current editing capability.

This implementation issue is outside the [Rework the militia UI for ease of use](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/99) planning map. Its authoring task is [Write the Navigation shell implementation spec](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/123). Baseline inspected: main at `eef41f7bad19e63ecce858e7a4490c937a4ece89`.

Own the new route structure, one top bar, campaign and organization switching, account/sign-in controls, campaign section links, phone bottom navigation and More sheet, legacy redirects, campaign-level authorization/unavailable presentation, maintenance banner and reusable failed-load component. Keep theme tokens/fonts and prefer shadcn/ui primitives. Route components remain thin; isolate campaign access/navigation orchestration from page editors and existing backend writes.

The [Week frame authoring owner](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/124) owns the stepper, reference panel, phase readiness/footer, save/other-player feedback and Confirmation transition. Provide integration positions without duplicating its state or moving existing feedback out of reach. The [Setup owner](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/130), [Militia corrections owner](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/131), [Characters & officers owner](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/132), [Finished weeks owner](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/133) and [Campaign list/home owner](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/134) own their eventual page designs and layout skeletons. Their current contents remain usable until replacement delivery. This issue introduces no page redesign, new rules or backend contract.

## 2. Decision sources

Read these complete discussions; later approved amendments override older mock behavior:

- [What navigation structure should the live flow have? — resolution](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/102#issuecomment-5831173561), including the [team-manager amendment](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/102#issuecomment-5831430773).
- [How should loading, unavailable, failed and maintenance-pause states look across the new structure? — resolution](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/119#issuecomment-5846266381).
- [How should the shell and week screen adapt to phone and desktop? — approved variant B](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/120#issuecomment-5846493929).
- [What should the campaign list and creation look like, and does a campaign get its own home view? — resolution](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/118#issuecomment-5846080538).
- [Should first-time setup and militia corrections be one workflow or two? — route and editor ownership amendment](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/103#issuecomment-5834024251).
- [How should the agreed designs be split into per-area spec issues, and in what order should they roll out? — common template and completion gate](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/122#issuecomment-5846600504).

Apply these precedence points explicitly: `/campaigns/<id>` is the selected-campaign list/home route, **not** the earlier proposed redirect to the week; every campaign section stays visible before militia setup, superseding the early two-tab shell; direct setup bookmarks for started militias show the later already-set-up state; `/militia/correct` is replaced by in-place corrections on `/militia`; team managers remain with teams. The old three-tab reference-panel mock is not this shell's content contract: Week frame owns the later now/after and This phase design. Shell and Week frame must not depend on the future finished-weeks listing query (rollout 11); keep current Finished weeks access and use only existing `canonicalHistory.read` where history data is needed before that delivery.

### Shell behavior acceptance

- **Tablet landscape (primary):** no app sidebar; slim top bar with Keep link, campaign switcher ending in **All campaigns…**, section links **Week N**, **Finished weeks**, **Militia**, **Characters & officers**, and organization/account controls on the right. The Week label can omit its number until known. Keep and All campaigns lead to `/campaigns`. Only the week mounts week-specific status/reference controls. Other sections use the page area without a week panel.
- **Phone:** below the prototype's `md` breakpoint (768px), retain the brand and campaign switcher above the page and place the four sections plus **More** in a bottom bar. More opens a shadcn sheet with organization and account/sign-in controls. Visual labels may shorten as the prototype does, but accessible names identify the full section. Reserve room for Week frame's status strip immediately above the bar. Content, alerts and editor save buttons must remain reachable above navigation, including safe areas and the on-screen keyboard. Close More on selection; restore focus on dismissal. No floating sidebar trigger remains.
- **Desktop:** at 1280px and above retain top navigation and give the week host bounded remaining viewport space so Week frame can implement its scrolling middle column with stepper rail and docked panel. Do not apply the future week-only no-page-scroll rule to all hosted legacy forms. Current forms remain scrollable; later non-week owners supply their own responsive page layouts.
- **Campaign list/root:** organization switcher occupies the breadcrumb position after Keep; account is on the right. Preserve the existing picker, create dialog/form and first-campaign default as a temporary scaffold. `/campaigns/<id>` selects that campaign in the same scaffold and exposes links to its current screens. Do not redirect the selected-campaign address to the week, silently select another campaign when an explicit id is unavailable, or implement the final home pane early. The list no longer embeds another copy of the week editor.
- **Campaign switching:** list only the active organization's campaigns. Put selection in the campaign route so refresh and browser Back/Forward retain the selected campaign. Campaign switching never carries an old campaign's history record id, query cache, pending editor state or draft identity into the new campaign. Selecting a campaign opens its selected-campaign route; the existing screen links then choose the section. Switching the active organization from a campaign page goes to `/campaigns` for the new organization.
- **Loading/access:** render the shell immediately with name/account skeletons while their data is pending. Once campaign access is resolved, section links remain ordinary links and work even if the page fails. Do not flash a stale campaign name or page from the previous organization while checking access.
- **Unavailable:** an invalid id, deleted campaign, non-member campaign or campaign outside the active organization has the same neutral campaign-level presentation replacing tabs/page: **This campaign isn't available in [active organization name].**, organization switcher and **Back to campaigns**. Keep brand, organization and account controls. If there is no selected organization, offer the organization chooser without inventing an organization name. Signed out, show **Sign in to open this campaign.** with **Sign in**. Preserve the requested destination through sign-in when supported by the existing auth flow. No automatic organization switching or existence disclosure.
- **Maintenance:** show **Campaign editing is paused for maintenance. Please try again shortly.** on the campaign list and every campaign section, including load/empty/error screens. Tablet/desktop places it under the top bar; the later approved phone treatment places it above the top bar. It does not replace readable content or disable edit controls. Writes still use existing failure feedback and the server's pause message.
- **Failed loads:** provide one accessible alert card with a page noun and **Try again**, whose callback retries that page's data. A page failure must not swallow the shell or prevent section navigation. Keep the message neutral; membership failure is the separate campaign-level state. Adopt this wrapper for current hosted page failures as they are adapted, retaining their retry behavior. Page-shaped skeletons and refined empty states belong to the named page owners; keep current readable loading status text for screen readers throughout.

## 3. Prototypes

| Purpose | Branch and pinned commit | Approved route / variant |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Tablet navigation and section placement | [`prototype/navigation` at `76c4d9a4eccffc48d99fb55f8c64788c4ec2a6b8`](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/tree/76c4d9a4eccffc48d99fb55f8c64788c4ec2a6b8) | `/prototype/navigation?variant=E` — E, top bar plus docked reference panel |
| Phone shell and desktop host constraints | [`prototype/responsive-shell` at `de10f4208904ca583d0fbc143bfc6314f0b9c0e7`](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/tree/de10f4208904ca583d0fbc143bfc6314f0b9c0e7) | `/prototype/responsive-shell?variant=B`; direct `/prototype/responsive-shell/screen?variant=B&phase=activity` — B, Bottom bar and sheets |

Run the prototype branch with `pnpm prototype`; do not merge either prototype or copy its mocked data/auth/status behavior into production. Review tablet landscape 1180×820 (plus the existing 1194×834 E2E viewport), phone 390×844 and landscape, and desktop 1440×900. The shared-state decision has no separate prototype. The later amendments in section 2, functional links instead of mock spans, existing editable pages during rollout, and real campaign/membership state are intentional differences from these pinned snapshots.

## 4. Capability accounting

`docs/ui-capability-inventory.md` remains the current-behavior inventory. Append planned coverage until implementation lands; update current locations and E2E evidence only when actually shipped. Every id below is explicitly retained, replaced with an approved equivalent, or shared with a named owner.

| Exact inventory id | This delivery's acceptance / coverage | Owner or handoff |
| --- | --- | --- |
| NAV-01 | Approved sidebar retirement; remove sidebar/rail UI without losing its destinations. Its remembered open/closed affordance moves to the week reference panel. Inventory currently marks the approved removal although main still renders the sidebar. | Shell removal; Week frame owns persistent panel visibility. |
| NAV-02 | Keep logo opens `/campaigns` on all shell layouts. | Shell; Campaign list/home reuses. |
| NAV-03 | Preserve the home-navigation function via `/` → `/campaigns` and Keep/All campaigns; the placeholder/My Keep destination is the explicitly approved replacement, not lost functionality. | Shell; Campaign list/home reuses. |
| NAV-04 | Campaign-list navigation stays reachable with active location communicated. | Shell. |
| NAV-05 | Sign in reachable when signed out, including phone More and protected destination state. | Shell. |
| NAV-06 | Organization control available throughout, properly filters selection and returns to campaign list on change. | Shell; Campaign list/home owns final list states. |
| NAV-07 | Account and sign-out retained in top bar/More. | Shell. |
| NAV-08 | Auth-loading text is replaced by accessible account skeleton. | Shell. |
| NAV-09 | Phone trigger's navigation reachability is replaced by bottom tabs and More. | Shell, approved responsive rearrangement. |
| NAV-10 | Finished weeks section link preserves selected campaign; temporary existing inline link may remain. | Shell route; Week frame owns reference-panel entry. |
| NAV-11 | Set up militia links from hosted no-militia Week/Militia resolve within this campaign. | Shell route; Week frame and Militia corrections own final empty pages. |
| NAV-12 | Return from history to this campaign's current week stays reachable through Week tab and existing link. | Shell; Finished weeks owns record-pane return CTA. |
| NAV-13 | Completed setup's Open week N works; later state also offers Open militia. | Shell route; Setup owns final started-militia page. |
| NAV-14 | Successful setup opens the same campaign's week at the requested valid phase. | Shell route integration; Setup owns initialization and collision behavior. |
| NAV-15 | All five phase URL values and invalid→Upkeep behavior retained; navigation remains player-local. | Shell parser/navigation bridge; Week frame owns interactive phase navigation and eligibility. |
| NAV-16 | Existing week and ledger functionality is reachable in the four campaign sections. | Shell temporary hosting; downstream page owners replace contents. |
| CAMP-01 | Active organization campaign picker and first-campaign default retained; top-bar switcher on campaign pages. | Shared with Campaign list/home, which owns final list rows. |
| CAMP-02 | Explicit route selection survives reload and campaign changes isolate content. | Shell route context; Campaign list/home owns final pane selection. |
| CAMP-03 | Existing create dialog remains reachable on `/campaigns` until the pane form replaces it. | Temporary shell reachability; Campaign list/home owns full capability and approved result-shape change. |
| CAMP-04 | Existing empty-organization create entry remains reachable. | Temporary shell reachability; Campaign list/home owns final empty layout. |
| CAMP-05 | Members see permitted campaign contents; outsiders and wrong-organization deep links cannot expose them. | Shell campaign gate; all page owners retain server-side authorization. |
| STATE-01 | Non-blocking maintenance banner on every hosted page and list. | Shell. |
| STATE-02 | Shell/account/name loading scaffold and readable current page loading states. | Shell; Campaign list/home owns list skeleton; each page owner owns its full skeleton. |
| STATE-03 | Shared failed-load card and page-local retry while navigation remains usable. | Shell component; Campaign list/home owns list failure; other owners supply their noun/retry. |
| STATE-04 | Organization chooser and campaign-level wrong-organization recovery. | Shell; Campaign list/home owns final no-organization/list-access presentation. |
| STATE-05 | Centralize campaign access decisions without losing current week/setup/history loading, retry and unavailable coverage. | Shell access boundary; Week frame, Setup and Finished weeks own page states. |
| STATE-06 | Reload and multi-device changes remain intact through routes and hosting. | Shared regression obligation of every owner. |
| WEEK-03 | Changing one player's phase URL or tab never changes another player's Phase View. | Preserve now; Week frame owns full behavior. |
| WEEK-08 | Shell links/campaign changes must not bypass existing pending-save/Confirmation departure protection. | Preserve/adapt now; Week frame owns ongoing feedback and barrier. |
| WEEK-12 | Valid campaign with no militia retains setup path; true campaign unavailability goes to shell; page failure has Try again. | Shared with Week frame. |
| SETUP-22, SETUP-23 | Hosted setup still has completed/loading/access behavior; preserve bookmarks and current startup behavior. | Shared with Setup, which delivers the later already-set-up page and layout skeleton. |
| HIST-02, HIST-03, HIST-07 | Keep previous/next/latest, selected audit entry and Earlier entries functional within the same campaign; adapt route inputs without changing the history query. Keep loading/failure/empty behavior. | Shell history-route adapter; Finished weeks owns record browsing and final states. |
| LEDG-01, LEDG-03, LEDG-05, LEDG-06, LEDG-09, LEDG-10 | Existing correction form, roster/officer/team-manager assignment, required reason, save/conflict behavior and pre-setup character access stay reachable. | Temporary shell hosting; Militia corrections and Characters & officers own replacements. |
| CHAR-01, CHAR-08, CHAR-09 | Existing CharacterManager stays reachable and reactive, including pre-setup, empty and archive states; campaign context is explicit. | Temporary shell hosting; Characters & officers owns full record/list/state behavior. |
| NAV-17 (new, planned) | Campaign-scoped routes and legacy redirects preserve campaign, phase and supported history selection with reload/Back/Forward coverage. | Shell; later routes build on this contract. |
| STATE-07 (new, planned) | Single neutral campaign-level sign-in/unavailable state with organization chooser and safe recovery. | Shell; all campaign pages consume it. |

**Approved removals/replacements only:** sidebar NAV-01 and placeholder navigation NAV-03 per [navigation approval](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/102#issuecomment-5831173561); NAV-09 mobile trigger replaced by bottom navigation per [responsive approval](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/120#issuecomment-5846493929); impossible **Select a campaign…** fragment of CHAR-09 per [shared-state approval](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/119#issuecomment-5846266381), with other character states retained; standalone `/militia/correct` address replaced by `/militia` per [correction approval](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/103#issuecomment-5834024251). No character fields, archive controls, correction fields, history/audit capabilities or in-flight protection are removed. Final record CRUD remains Characters & officers' ownership even where the existing widget temporarily appears on more than one page.

## 5. Data, payloads and rules

**No schema, query/mutation argument, result-shape or Weekly Resolution change. No Ruleset Version bump and no data migration.** All campaign authorization remains server-enforced; the shell's gate is presentation and avoids rendering protected page subscriptions before identity/active-organization access is established.

Use existing `campaign.getCampaigns` through `src/lib/sharedQueries.ts` for the active organization's campaign list, existing Clerk state for auth/organization, `cutover.status` for maintenance, and current page query/mutation contracts. Do not add `getCampaign(id)`, infer membership from a guessed id, automatically switch organizations, or adopt later approved backend changes early. In particular createCampaign's id return/description editing belong to Campaign list/home; finished-weeks listing belongs to Finished weeks; character kind/rules migration belongs to Characters & officers.

Read current integration seams: `src/app/layout.tsx`, `src/app/appSidebar.tsx`, `src/app/campaigns/*`, `src/app/canonical-*/page.tsx`, `src/components/campaign-dashboard.tsx`, `canonical-campaign-dashboard.tsx`, `campaign-selector.tsx`, `character-manager.tsx`, `use-canonical-ledger.ts`, `militia-setup/screen.tsx`, `historical-week/screen.tsx`, and `weekly-draft-workspace/board.tsx`. Reuse their controllers/hooks; don't fork the draft store or create a second active editor per campaign.

URL parsing and route-adapter props are client/navigation changes. Existing `canonicalHistory.read` already accepts `week`, `recordId`, `beforeSequence`; use those existing arguments for supported historical selection. Main currently keeps them in local `HistoryBrowser` state, so preserve that selection when adapting routes and browser history; do not claim old `/canonical-history` already interpreted those URL keys. Omitted history selection still opens the latest effective record. Validate numeric selectors structurally and leave record ownership to the existing backend. Malformed URL input cannot crash the shell or expose data.

A campaign/organization transition must discard old page-local subscriptions/views only through the existing pending-edit safeguards and must never retarget a delayed save to the next campaign. Phase changes remain local; don't persist phase in militia state. Existing snapshot, revision, stale-review, one-open-draft and immutable-history contracts remain untouched. Any extra backend change discovered in implementation requires the map's explicit human approval before proceeding with that change.

## 6. Validation and coverage

Retain **every existing `e2e/` scenario**. Update semantic navigation locators and helpers for links/bottom tabs and scoped addresses; keep legacy URL assertions as redirect tests instead of deleting their journeys. Preserve the auth harness and required-result gates; no skipping or weakening scenarios to accommodate the shell.

| Existing scenario | Equivalent behavior after shell delivery |
| --- | --- |
| `access.spec.ts` and `support/nightly-flows.ts` | Member campaign visibility versus outsider, supported campaign selection and full nightly character editing/reload journey. Existing Active campaign picker remains in the temporary list; future list owner rewrites it to rows. |
| `character-ledger.spec.ts` | Two players share character changes and persistent officer assignment with required correction reason; visit Characters & officers for records and the retained Militia correction editor for assignment. |
| `existing-militia.spec.ts` and `support/setup-workspace.ts` | Mid-campaign setup, fields/warnings/errors and starting phase survive navigation/reload in the correct campaign. |
| `realtime-action-slot.spec.ts` | Shared Action Slot staging and reload persistence; both contexts remain in their own local route/phase. |
| `complete-week.spec.ts` | Confirmation, next week, reload outcome and navigation to immutable history. |
| `canonical-workspace.spec.ts` and `support/activity-workspace.ts`, `event-workspace.ts`, `persistent-workspace.ts`, `persistent-qa.ts`, `summary-qa.ts` | Existing shared edits, independent phase navigation, pending departure warning, rejection/recovery, optimistic feedback, full phase decisions, warnings, Rules Exceptions, Table Adjustments, Confirmation, keyboard/tap/drag and responsive assertions. Phase redesign owners may later rewrite interactions with equivalent approved behavior. |
| `canonical-cutover.spec.ts` | Accepted source preserves canonical state/history after reload; retired backend paths still reject. These are unrelated to retaining old frontend bookmarks. |
| `canonical-persistence.spec.ts` and `canonical-confirmation.spec.ts` | Keep all direct Convex editing/Confirmation contracts, real auth/isolation, rollback, concurrent/stale review/delayed edits/dropped acknowledgements and historical-view assertions. They remain required although absent from most inventory E2E cells. |

Add focused shell/route acceptance checks for:

1. `/` and each legacy address, missing campaign, encoded campaign id, all valid phases, invalid phase fallback, valid history week/audit selection and reload/Back/Forward. New-history links choose the requested week without dropping the campaign or audit paging. Browser Back does not create a second draft store.
2. All four sections and Setup reachable at phone/tablet/desktop; normal/focused/active states; keyboard traversal; More opens/closes accessibly; visible content never disappears below fixed controls. No horizontal page scroll at test widths, including long campaign names and maintenance copy.
3. Signed-out, resolving-auth, invalid/deleted id, outsider, wrong active organization, no organization, no militia, page-query failure/retry and maintenance. A failed page leaves section navigation usable. An explicitly unavailable selected campaign never falls back to another campaign's data. The wrong-organization state offers selection; changing organization returns to its list, and reopening the bookmarked campaign then works if permitted.
4. Two members can independently navigate while seeing shared edits; section/campaign/organization navigation preserves pending-edit/Confirmation departure safety and does not leak one campaign's draft/history/characters into another. Realtime UI continues after reload.
5. Current create, character archive/unarchive, officer/roster correction, team-manager assignment and historical audit paging remain reachable before any later redesign. Pause keeps existing data readable; an attempted write shows the existing server pause failure through ordinary feedback.

Run `pnpm -s typecheck`, `pnpm -s lint`, relevant local route/component tests, and the affected required/nightly E2E scenarios through the existing declared isolated-preview harness. Preserve direct contract checks. Report actual executed checks and environment limitations rather than treating unrun live-service coverage as passed. This issue's authoring does not require deploying or running the application.

## 7. Routes and rollout

| Route | Initial shell delivery | Later owner / compatibility |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `/` | Redirect to `/campaigns`. | Keep existing home-navigation destination functional. |
| `/campaigns` | Existing campaign picker/create and empty states, inside list shell; navigation into selected campaign sections. | Campaign list/home replaces scaffold with approved list/detail layout. |
| `/campaigns/<id>` | Same scaffold with explicit selected campaign; no redirect and no duplicate embedded week. | Campaign list/home delivers final home pane. |
| `/campaigns/<id>/week?phase=…` | Host existing `CanonicalWorkspaceScreen` and its current phase editors once. Accept `upkeep`, `activity`, `event`, `persistent`, `summary`; invalid/absent phase falls back to Upkeep. Preserve existing Persistent Phase Eligibility enforcement. | Week frame replaces its chrome, then phase owners replace editors. |
| `/campaigns/<id>/history?week=<n>` | Host current historical browser; adapt selected week plus existing `recordId`/`beforeSequence` selection without changing query payload. Preserve latest/effective defaults, previous/next and audit paging. | Finished weeks replaces layout and adds its approved listing query. |
| `/campaigns/<id>/militia` | Host existing ledger/correction editor including roster, officers and managers; required reasons and current save/conflict behavior unchanged. CharacterManager may remain in this legacy host until its replacement is reachable on Characters & officers. | Militia corrections replaces sections; retains legacy roster/officer editing until Characters & officers ships. Managers stay with teams permanently. |
| `/campaigns/<id>/characters` | Host existing `CharacterManager` including create/edit/archive/unarchive/empty/error behavior; a clear link to **Militia** keeps the currently required roster/officer correction editor reachable. Before setup, character CRUD still works. | Characters & officers replaces the host with role cards/table and roster/officer corrections. |
| `/campaigns/<id>/setup` | Host existing setup form, its current validation/start flow and completed-page return link. | Setup delivers nine steps and the later **This militia is already set up.** page with Open week N/Open militia. |
| `/campaigns/<id>/militia/correct` | Do not introduce a new correction page; redirect an incoming address to `/campaigns/<id>/militia`. Existing correction control remains reachable there. | In-place correction address amendment. |
| `/canonical-workspace?campaign=X&phase=Y` | Redirect to `/campaigns/X/week?phase=Y`, then normalize invalid phase. | Preserve context; no legacy editor rendered. |
| `/canonical-setup?campaign=X` | Redirect to `/campaigns/X/setup`. | Started-militia bookmarks must still reach the setup state, not be forced to week by the redirect layer. |
| `/canonical-history?campaign=X` | Redirect to `/campaigns/X/history`; forward supported `week`, `recordId`, `beforeSequence` selection if present. | Existing route only read campaign; new adapter can represent already-supported browser/query selection. |
| Any above legacy route without campaign | Redirect to `/campaigns`. | Never assemble a guessed campaign address. |

No implementation blocker: this is the first shipping issue. Register a **native implementation dependency** from Week frame's output issue to this issue; later implementations follow the twelve-area shipping chain agreed in the rollout resolution. The authoring tasks are separate and are not runtime/implementation blockers. When their output issues exist, cross-link them by name.

Cutover from the old dashboard removes the duplicate embedded week only after the scoped week and corresponding links work. Do not remove existing correction/character controls merely because the final prototype omits them. The Militia roster/officer fallback ends only when the Characters & officers replacement supplies every equivalent operation with reason, validation, access and realtime behavior. Campaign picker/create fallback ends when Campaign list/home ships. Page-state refinements replace the existing page states in each area's delivery; central campaign access and maintenance apply immediately.

### Published implementation handoffs

This is the first implementation in the agreed rollout. The next shipping area is [Implement the shared Week frame and cross-device week transition](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/137). The native dependencies between implementation issues encode this shipping order; authoring tasks are already complete.

Other referenced implementation contracts: [Implement guided Militia Setup with browser resume](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/138), [Implement in-place Militia corrections and reference repair](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/139), [Implement Characters & officers with role corrections and compatible kind migration](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/141), [Implement Finished weeks with immutable records and paged audit history](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/146), [Implement the Campaign list and home with scoped creation and editing](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/147).

## 8. Shippable when

- All scoped routes, context-preserving old bookmarks and browser navigation work from a fresh load; `/campaigns/<id>` honors the approved list/home address. Only one week editor is mounted.
- Tablet top bar, phone bottom bar/More and desktop host are functional with theme/fonts intact, accessible controls and no clipped editors. Week-specific future controls have a clear Week frame handoff.
- Campaign access is checked before page contents render; signed-out/unavailable states are neutral and recoverable. Changing organization cannot expose stale campaign data. Maintenance keeps pages readable and existing write failure behavior intact. Page failures leave navigation usable.
- Every current editor, creation path, character operation, roster/officer/team-manager correction and audit control remains reachable through the documented temporary hosts; no schema/payload/rules drift or premature backend migration.
- Existing multiplayer, pending-save, Confirmation and history guarantees pass their equivalent scenarios. The capability inventory records shipped locations/coverage and retains the named downstream handoffs.
- `pnpm -s typecheck`, `pnpm -s lint` and relevant tests pass, with actual live E2E evidence reported for affected journeys and service contracts. No prototype branch is merged.

When creating implementation tickets from this spec, follow the [source traceability requirements](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/148#source-traceability-and-future-tickets): link back to this spec and carry forward the relevant decision-comment permalinks, amendments, pinned prototypes and capability IDs from the sections below.

## 1. Scope and ownership

Deliver the Week frame as **rollout position 2 of 12**, around the existing Upkeep, Activity, Event, Persistent and Summary editors. Players can see what remains to decide, consult militia values, navigate independently and understand shared changes without losing any editing or Confirmation capability.

This implementation issue is outside the [Rework the militia UI for ease of use](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/99) planning map; authored by [Write the Week frame implementation spec](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/124). Inspected main code at `eef41f7bad19e63ecce858e7a4490c937a4ece89`; current authoring baseline `6836fadf2ec5430f725681df1a3fb9b066fb7dcc` adds only Navigation shell inventory accounting.

Own Phase View navigation, Phase Readiness, the reference panel, This phase, the footer and responsive replacements; shared optimistic/save/error/other-player feedback, pending departure protection, week page states and the cross-device transition after Confirmation. Consume the shell from [Implement the campaign navigation shell and scoped routes](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/135), including its top-bar integration positions, campaign access boundary, maintenance banner, section navigation and failed-load component.

The [Review & confirm owner](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/129) owns the eventual review block, Confirmation controls and six-section Summary redesign. Preserve the current `SummaryView` and Confirmation contract during this delivery; no replacement review flow or additional Confirmation control. Apply the approved frame caption/footer changes here; the later owner applies the review-block copy removals and Go links when replacing that editor. The [Upkeep](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/125), [Activity](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/126), [Event](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/127) and [Persistent](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/128) owners replace their editors in subsequent deliveries. Keep their current fields, choice cards, validation, Rules Exceptions and warnings working now.

### Frame acceptance

- Five positions always appear in rules order: **Upkeep, Activity, Event, Persistent, Review & confirm**. The URL value remains `summary` for the last. Week N in the shell and the selected step replace the duplicate **Week N · Phase** heading; retain an accessible page heading identifying both.
- Derive all five Phase Views from one current source snapshot, optimistic Weekly Draft and Resolution Preview. For the first four steps show a check when ready, otherwise the number of open decisions, and a separate warning count when present. Advisory warnings can coexist with ready. Count unique requirement/warning identities within their phase, retaining separate items that happen to have identical wording. Use existing phase facts and message formatters, never a separate rules implementation.
- Persistent remains visible and disabled with **No carried events** when the draft's fixed `persistentPhaseEligible` is false. Creating or ending events during this week cannot change that eligibility. A direct ineligible `phase=persistent` request normalizes to Upkeep. Previous/next skips the locked position without hiding it; endpoints do not wrap.
- Phase navigation is local and remains usable while ordinary saves are pending. Update the local route without disposing/recreating the campaign's draft store, clearing pending operations or changing another player's Phase View. Deep links, reload and browser Back/Forward choose the valid requested Phase View; invalid/absent values choose Upkeep. No phase navigation writes to Convex.
- **Review & confirm has no readiness caption**, including the phone step sheet/current-step caption and desktop rail. In Summary, the footer shows only a disabled-Confirmation reason when needed, such as **2 decisions left** or **Review will be ready when your changes are saved.** It is empty when ready; do not introduce the removed ready/needs-attention sentence. While a fresh review is required, the footer directs the player to review the updated week and does not imply readiness permits confirmation. The existing review controls remain authoritative.
- For other phases, the pinned footer has previous, the current phase's readiness line, and next. Event advances directly to Review & confirm when Persistent is locked; otherwise Persistent precedes it. Readiness is informational, not a lock on navigation. Current editors' required decisions and warning details stay reachable even when the panel is closed.

### Reference panel and feedback acceptance

- On tablet/desktop the closable docked panel is read-only and appears only on Week. Remember its open/closed preference locally as the old sidebar did; do not share this preference or Phase View between players. **This phase** sits above the panel tabs and lists the current phase's open decisions and warnings in plain language. Summary uses its aggregate facts; phase and item warnings remain in their editor as well.
- The **Militia** tab displays **Now / After the week**: rank, training, treasury and its minimum, notoriety, focus, team conditions (active/disabled/missing, without hiding any existing exceptional status), actions used versus allowance, event chance and carried persistent events. Now comes from the current source snapshot; After the week comes from the same Resolution Preview used by the editors, including Table Adjustments where a final outcome exists. Label draft-only context such as actions used clearly; never invent a historical/current value where no comparable value exists. Use existing rule helpers for thresholds/allowances. Distinguish an incomplete forecast with an unavailable/awaiting-decisions value rather than displaying zero or a prior week's after-value as final.
- Preserve the **Officers** and **History** reference tabs from the navigation decision. Officers displays current read-only roster/officer information and **Characters & officers**. Managers remain with teams on Militia. Militia includes **Open militia**; History includes available recent effective finished weeks and **All finished weeks**. Each link keeps this campaign. Use the existing history reader's latest/previous-week navigation for a small bounded recent list (at most three); do not create a new query, fake record dates, treat multiple audit entries as separate finished weeks or scan all history. Its loading/failure/empty state is local to the History tab and never blocks editing. The later Finished weeks implementation owns its new listing query and may replace this adapter while retaining these links.
- One status line integrates into the shell: **Prepare the week together.**, **Saving changes…**, **Changes saved.**, **Changes could not be saved. The latest saved values are shown.**, **Confirming the week…**. Failed-save styling is red plus text/accessible alert; color alone is insufficient. Restore the latest saved values and preserve the existing fresh-review requirement after rejection. Where a server failure supplies the maintenance reason, preserve its ordinary failure presentation.
- Beside it show **Another player changed [phase]** for a remote accepted change. Derive the changed phase(s) from accepted revisions; multiple changed areas must not be falsely attributed to one arbitrary phase. Exclude optimistic local edits, their acknowledgements, initial load and new-week transitions. Shared adjudication changes belong to Review & confirm. Do not add actor identity, timestamps or another backend payload. Remote updates refresh readiness and references while leaving this player's selected phase and focus alone.
- A **Setup notes** button beside the status opens the existing notes only when notes exist. Notes stay readable, including on phone; they are no longer a permanent panel. Use an accessible shadcn popover/dialog/sheet with focus return.
- Preserve departure protection while edits or Confirmation are pending, including browser unload and shell section/campaign/organization changes; a phase-only navigation keeps pending work and does not prompt. Coordinate the shell's guard so it cannot bypass the pending state. Never retarget a delayed save to a new campaign or draft.

### Confirmation transition and states

- Keep every weekly editing input disabled while the local Confirmation request is in flight. Navigation/reference reading remains available; no slot claims, player roles or global editing locks are introduced. Other devices retain existing concurrency handling until the authoritative next draft arrives.
- During the handoff, retain the last rendered week and its reference facts instead of flashing a loading skeleton. For the initiating device the existing Confirm control reads **Confirming…** until the next open Weekly Draft is usable. If a device observes closure before it receives the successor, retain the old view as read-only while waiting; do not allow editing the closed draft or showing old facts under the new week number. Handle rejection as the existing stale-review/failure path, without claiming success.
- When the next Weekly Draft arrives, every connected device moves to Upkeep, updates its local `phase=upkeep`, and shows the short notice **Week N confirmed.** with **Open in Finished weeks** linking to `/campaigns/<id>/history?week=N`. Announce once per observed same-campaign week transition, including on a device that did not press Confirm. No notice on initial load, ordinary revision changes or campaign/organization switches; never infer confirmation solely from a higher week number across unrelated sources. Use existing source/draft identity observations. A delayed old edit must neither affect the new week nor erase the notice. The notice is transient client UI, not a new stored fact.
- Initial week loading renders the stepper/panel/footer skeleton inside the already-rendered shell, with **Loading the week…** available as screen-reader status. A failure uses the shell's **The week could not be loaded.** card and **Try again** to retry the week's subscriptions/data without losing section navigation. A valid campaign with no militia shows **No militia yet.** and **Set up militia** for that campaign. Signed-out/invalid/deleted/wrong-organization/non-member cases belong to the shell's neutral campaign access state, not this no-militia state.
- Consume the shared maintenance banner on every state. Data remains readable and editing is not preemptively disabled because of maintenance; attempted writes retain the existing server failure behavior.

### Responsive and accessibility acceptance

Use existing theme tokens/fonts and shadcn components. At tablet landscape (1180×820 and the existing 1194×834 touch test size), use the full-width stepper under the top bar, scrolling phase content, approximately 320px docked reference panel, and pinned footer. Closing the panel gives its space to the editor.

Below 768px, the shell owns bottom section tabs/More. This issue supplies one **Step N of 5 · Phase** button with current glyph and five-segment progress indicator; its sheet lists all five steps with readiness/locked semantics and no Summary caption. Replace the separate footer/panel with a status strip immediately above the bottom tabs: Training and Treasury now → after, decision/warning indication, and previous/next arrows. Tapping the strip opens a sheet with full reference values, This phase, and reachable reference tabs/links. Keep setup notes, save failure and other-player announcements accessible when their header representations are icons. Summary's strip follows the same caption/readiness removal as its footer while retaining values and warning access.

From 1280px, the week uses three columns: stepper rail, independently scrolling main editor at a comfortable width, and docked reference panel. The page itself does not scroll; footer sits below the middle column only. Long panel contents must scroll within their own available height. At all sizes, reserve space for navigation, banners, keyboard and safe areas so fields, dialogs, notices and Confirmation remain reachable without horizontal page scrolling. The hosted old editors must remain usable at each size now; phase-specific redesigned card grids/wrapping are the corresponding phase owners' later work.

Use real buttons/links, clear accessible current/disabled labels, keyboard navigation and visible focus. Sheets/dialogs have labels, focus containment, Escape/dismiss and focus return. Announce saved/failed/remote/confirmed changes politely except actionable errors; do not repeatedly announce every derived count while typing. Counts/glyphs need text equivalents.

## 2. Decision sources

Read the full discussions, including amendments; later approved decisions override earlier text or mock behavior:

- [What shared layout should the week screen use across phases? — variant A](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/101#issuecomment-5831260876).
- [What navigation structure should the live flow have? — variant E](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/102#issuecomment-5831173561) and its [team-manager amendment](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/102#issuecomment-5831430773).
- [How should loading, unavailable, failed and maintenance-pause states look across the new structure?](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/119#issuecomment-5846266381), including the cross-device confirmed-week notice.
- [How should the shell and week screen adapt to phone and desktop? — variant B](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/120#issuecomment-5846493929).
- [How should Summary lay out the review, Table Adjustments and the outcome? — approved frame/review amendments](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/110#issuecomment-5844063536): no Review & confirm caption; no ready/needs-attention sentence in review/footer; no applies-the-whole-week note. Disabled-Confirmation reasons remain. Review-block removals ship with that owner, not by deleting its controls here.
- [How should the agreed designs be split into per-area spec issues, and in what order should they roll out?](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/122#issuecomment-5846600504), including shared ownership and staged preservation of old editors.

## 3. Prototypes

| Purpose | Branch and pinned commit | Approved route / variant |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Week frame at tablet landscape | [`prototype/week-layout` at `14659d7dc6dc9062098055e29508fa3327912402`](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/tree/14659d7dc6dc9062098055e29508fa3327912402) | `/prototype/week-layout?variant=A` — A |
| Shell/reference tabs | [`prototype/navigation` at `76c4d9a4eccffc48d99fb55f8c64788c4ec2a6b8`](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/tree/76c4d9a4eccffc48d99fb55f8c64788c4ec2a6b8) | `/prototype/navigation?variant=E` — E |
| Phone and desktop | [`prototype/responsive-shell` at `de10f4208904ca583d0fbc143bfc6314f0b9c0e7`](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/tree/de10f4208904ca583d0fbc143bfc6314f0b9c0e7) | `/prototype/responsive-shell?variant=B`; direct `/prototype/responsive-shell/screen?variant=B&phase=activity` — B |
| Later Summary amendments | [`prototype/summary` at `65d472dcf4bb65094efb97b621c7bbae3ee18965`](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/tree/65d472dcf4bb65094efb97b621c7bbae3ee18965) | `/prototype/summary?variant=B` — B; reference for frame amendments, main editor owned separately |

Run `pnpm prototype` in the corresponding unmerged branch. Mocks are visual references, not a data/payload or authorization contract. Apply the source precedence above even if a snapshot still displays an old caption. The loading/error/confirmation-notice decision has no separate prototype. Do not merge prototype code or ship prototype-state controls.

## 4. Capability accounting

The existing inventory describes current behavior, not this unbuilt frame. Preserve IDs and append planned ownership; update current-location and actual coverage columns only when implementation lands.

| ID | Acceptance / disposition | Ownership / handoff |
| --- | --- | --- |
| WEEK-01 | Week N plus selected phase replaces the duplicate heading while preserving accessible week/phase context. | Frame; shell renders Week tab. |
| WEEK-02 | Five-step navigation, all-phase readiness, locked Persistent, footer and This phase. | Frame; phases supply facts. |
| WEEK-03 | Player-local navigation survives saving, URL changes and Back/Forward. | Frame; shell route adapter. |
| WEEK-04 | All edits remain shared in real time without claims/locks; remote-change notice. | Frame feedback; each editor keeps existing writes. |
| WEEK-05 | Immediate optimistic preview refreshes values, counts and editor. | Frame/store; all phase consumers. |
| WEEK-06 | One accessible save/error/confirming status in the shell, including phone icons. | Frame; shell placement. |
| WEEK-07 | Rejected edit restores saved values and invalidates review. | Frame/store; Review & confirm renders recovery control. |
| WEEK-08 | Pending departure protection covers unload and section/campaign/organization exits. | Frame plus shell guard. |
| WEEK-09 | Existing setup notes move into a reachable button/panel. | Frame. |
| WEEK-10 | Weekly editing disabled during Confirmation, including retained editors and open input surfaces. | Frame plus Review & confirm control. |
| WEEK-11 | Every device transitions to next-week Upkeep without a skeleton flash. | Frame/store; same Confirmation contract. |
| WEEK-12 | Week skeleton, neutral failed card/retry and no-militia setup path; campaign access handled outside. | Frame plus shell access boundary. |
| WEEK-13 | All existing choice interactions remain usable in hosted editors. | Shared: Upkeep, Activity, Event, Persistent, Review & confirm own their eventual approved tap/card controls; no global drag removal in frame. |
| WEEK-14 | Hosted whole-number inputs retain required/invalid distinction, clear/zero semantics and styled feedback. | Upkeep coordinates shared roll input work; every phase retains its own field validation; frame preserves access. |
| WEEK-15 | Existing ordered multi-die entry remains until approved dice-total migration. | Upkeep owns shared contract/read compatibility and updates Activity/Event/Persistent/Review & confirm consumers; frame introduces no roll-format change. |
| WEEK-16 | Out-of-range dice remain advisory and visible in editor/phase warnings. | Upkeep, Activity, Event, Persistent own inputs; frame aggregates warnings. |
| WEEK-17 | Tablet, phone and desktop frame replacements plus usable hosted editors, no clipped controls/horizontal page scroll. | Frame; each phase owns its later internal responsive redesign. |
| WEEK-18 | Existing structured list/nested/discriminated/modifier Save/Clear/add/remove operations stay usable. | Activity, Event, Persistent and Review & confirm own their editor replacements; frame cannot remove structured fields absent replacement coverage. |
| WEEK-19 — new, planned | Every observing device gets Week N confirmed and a correct historical-week link once the successor arrives. | Frame; Finished weeks owns destination. |
| NAV-01 | Remembered panel visibility replaces the retired sidebar's local preference. | Shell removes sidebar; frame preserves preference behavior. |
| NAV-10 | History reference tab, recent-week links and All finished weeks preserve campaign. | Frame; shell section link; Finished weeks owns final listing query/page. |
| NAV-11 | No-militia Week links to campaign Setup. | Frame; shell route; Setup destination. |
| NAV-15 | Five phase URL values, invalid fallback, Persistent eligibility and local Back/Forward. | Frame plus shell parser. |
| STATE-01 | Consume readable maintenance banner and existing write-failure path. | Shell owner; frame feedback. |
| STATE-02 | Week-shaped skeleton and accessible loading status. | Frame portion; shell name/account scaffold. |
| STATE-03 | Week failure uses shared card and page-local Try again; tabs remain usable. | Frame retry; shell component. |
| STATE-05 | Loading/failure/no militia is distinct from campaign unavailable. | Frame week portion; shell access; Setup/Finished weeks own theirs. |
| STATE-06 | Shared changes survive reload and cross-device navigation. | All owners; frame regression gate. |
| UPK-11 | Aggregate Upkeep warning visibility in This phase/counts. | Frame summary; Upkeep retains item warnings/reasons. |
| UPK-12 | Upkeep readiness in stepper/footer/This phase. | Frame; Upkeep facts/editor. |
| ACT-17 | Aggregate Activity warning/required-preparation visibility. | Frame summary; Activity owns per-choice warnings and hints. |
| EVT-11 | Aggregate Event warnings remain visible. | Frame summary; Event owns item warnings/Rules Exceptions. |
| EVT-14 | Required Event preparation remains visible. | Frame summary; Event owns per-occurrence list. |
| PER-08 | Aggregate Persistent warnings remain visible. | Frame summary; Persistent owns item warnings/Rules Exceptions. |
| PER-10 | Persistent preparation and earlier-phase dependencies remain visible. | Frame summary; Persistent owns item inputs. |
| SUM-01 | No Summary step caption or ready/needs-attention footer; retain disabled reason. | Frame chrome now; Review & confirm owns later block-copy removal. |
| SUM-02 | Aggregate required decisions available in This phase; hosted required list remains. | Review & confirm owns final review list and Go links; frame navigation supplies destination. |
| SUM-03 | Keep readiness/saved/reviewed Confirmation gate and hosted control. | Review & confirm owns final control; frame never infers confirmability from count alone. |
| SUM-04 | Concurrent Confirmation remains single-winner and stale-safe. | Existing persistence contract; shared frame/Review & confirm tests. |
| SUM-05 | Keep stale-review alert and Review updated week reachable after failure/remote changes. | Review & confirm owns control; frame/store carries invalidation. |
| SUM-09 | Aggregate warnings available in panel and preserved Summary warning list. | Frame summary; Review & confirm owns final list. |

SUM-06, SUM-07, SUM-08, SUM-10 and SUM-11 remain fully available through the hosted Summary; their presentation changes belong to Review & confirm. NAV-17/STATE-07 are already planned shell-owned IDs, not new IDs allocated by this issue.

**Signed-off replacements/removals:** WEEK-01's duplicate heading and the prototype's extra History icon are replaced by shell/phase/reference access under the [week-layout approval](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/101#issuecomment-5831260876); WEEK-09's permanent panel becomes its button there. The [Summary amendment](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/110#issuecomment-5844063536) removes only the named Summary caption/readiness sentences/note, not requirements, warnings, reasons or Confirmation controls. The [state approval](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/119#issuecomment-5846266381) replaces old week loading/error/unavailable presentation and Reload the week wording with skeleton/Try again/no-militia and shell access states. The [responsive approval](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/120#issuecomment-5846493929) replaces phone footer/stepper/panel with sheets/strip while preserving every capability. No phase field, structured control, roll semantics or choice operation is removed by this frame delivery.

## 5. Data, payloads and rules

**No schema, query/mutation argument, result-shape, rules or stored-data change; no Ruleset Version bump or migration.** Client presentation state/types may expose all Phase Views and transition feedback. Upkeep owns the later dice-total/transfer changes; other owners retain the rollout's specific approved backend changes. Do not pull them into this issue.

Use the current `weekly-draft-workspace` store/gateway/provider and `phaseView()`/phase facts, the existing `WorkspaceSource` and local `projectWeeklyDraft()` Resolution Preview. One campaign has one active editor/store. Derive readiness/reference values during store publication or render/memoization, not by maintaining independently synchronized React state/effects. Isolate navigation/feedback orchestration from presentational components and keep writes behind current gateways. Reuse current phase message formatting so internal requirement IDs, source/revision identifiers and transport terminology never leak into copy.

Current `store.ts` publishes loading when it lacks an open observation; this issue must adapt that presentation during a confirmed-draft handoff rather than reuse initial-load skeleton behavior. Retention is scoped to the same campaign/draft transition and must be cleared on access loss or campaign changes. The existing source identity guards, stale preview generations and transport targeting stay intact. All-phase readiness never substitutes for the accepted server preview and reviewed-revision contract used by `canConfirm`.

Read the existing `canonicalHistory.read` client contract for the History tab/notice destinations; its `week`, `recordId`, `beforeSequence`, `previousWeek` and `nextWeek` already support navigation. This issue may consume those existing contracts, not add a finished-weeks listing/result-date field. If reference data cannot be obtained with existing contracts, flag the exact missing field for approval rather than synthesizing data or broadening payloads.

Membership remains enforced server-side on every campaign read/write; the shell gate is presentation, not authorization. Clear prior campaign/source/notes/reference/remote-notice data on organization/access changes. No global/GM-only authority is introduced. Structural errors still block invalid writes; advisory rules warnings remain advisory unless the current resolution contract requires a decision/Rules Exception. This issue does not change existing action-capacity or other Confirmation rules under the guise of a new readiness display.

## 6. Validation and coverage

Retain all existing `e2e/` scenarios, including direct persistence/Confirmation scenarios outside the inventory mapping. Change UI selectors where approved, preserving assertions and coverage; do not skip tests because the location changed.

| Existing coverage | Required equivalent |
| --- | --- |
| `canonical-workspace.spec.ts`, `support/workspace.ts` | Optimistic/shared edits, independent Phase View, pending departure, save rejection/recovery, stale review, concurrent Confirmation, phase eligibility, setup context and responsive/keyboard/card interactions. Replace old heading/status/navigation selectors with semantic frame controls without dropping journeys. |
| `support/activity-workspace.ts`, `event-workspace.ts`, `persistent-workspace.ts`, `persistent-qa.ts`, `summary-qa.ts` | Every currently hosted field/choice/exception/outcome/adjustment remains operable through new frame; item warnings and Summary review gates remain. Drag tests continue for unchanged editors until their owning approved replacement lands. |
| `realtime-action-slot.spec.ts` | Two devices share slot placement/edits and reload persistence without shared phase navigation. |
| `complete-week.spec.ts` | Confirmation, correct successor week, persisted outcome and immutable history; add both-device notice/history destination assertions. |
| `existing-militia.spec.ts`, `support/setup-workspace.ts` | Mid-campaign entry preserves requested valid phase, setup notes, carried eligibility/context and first-week skip behavior. |
| `access.spec.ts`, `character-ledger.spec.ts`, `support/nightly-flows.ts` | Member/outsider isolation and shared officer changes remain intact through frame links/reference values and reload. Existing character and correction journeys remain required. |
| `canonical-persistence.spec.ts`, `canonical-confirmation.spec.ts` | Real auth/isolation, revision persistence, rollback, stale/concurrent Confirmation, delayed edits, dropped acknowledgements and history facts remain unchanged. |
| `canonical-cutover.spec.ts` | Canonical data/history survives reload and retired backend write paths remain rejected. |

Add focused store/component and browser coverage for:

1. Counts/This phase/reference values recompute across **all** phases for local optimistic and accepted remote edits. Ready with warnings is distinct from missing requirements; failed edits restore values/counts and invalidate review. Incomplete forecast is explicit. Summary has no caption/ready sentence in any frame representation; disabled reason remains.
2. Persistent locked at start stays locked if Event creates one; eligible remains viewable if Activity/Event ends all carried events. Next/previous skips locked Persistent; ineligible deep link normalizes without a write. All phase URLs and browser Back/Forward retain pending operations and do not move a second device.
3. Remote note is accurate for changed phase(s), never emitted for own acknowledgement or first load, and doesn't steal focus. Setup notes are present only when available and usable on each viewport. Remembered reference visibility is local; all tabs and History links retain campaign context; a panel-history failure leaves editor usable.
4. Hold the Confirmation acknowledgement and/or successor observation: old week remains, initiating control says Confirming, mutation inputs stay disabled, and no loading flash/false success occurs. Release the next draft: both devices choose Upkeep and each receives one notice linking to the confirmed week. Concurrent stale loser, failure, delayed old edit, reload and campaign switch cannot duplicate a commit/notice or leak old values into the new campaign.
5. Loading, page failure and retry, valid no militia, shell unavailable/signed out/other organization and maintenance at phone/tablet/desktop. No unauthorized content flash; tabs remain usable after page failure. Maintenance rejects writes through existing feedback while data stays readable.
6. Phone 390×844 and landscape, tablet 1180×820 plus 1194×834 touch, desktop 1440×900: sheets/strip/rail/footer, notes, long warnings, confirmation notice and every hosted control are reachable with no horizontal page scroll. Desktop panels scroll without page scroll; fixed phone bars never cover focused inputs or Confirmation. Keyboard/focus/accessible status assertions accompany pointer checks.

Run `pnpm -s typecheck`, `pnpm -s lint`, relevant workspace/store/component tests and affected required/nightly E2E through the declared isolated-preview harness in `e2e/README.md`. Report actual executed checks and any service limitations; unrun E2E is not a pass. This authoring task changes no application code and needs no deployment.

## 7. Routes and rollout

Implementation depends on [Implement the campaign navigation shell and scoped routes](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/135) through a native GitHub dependency. It precedes the Upkeep implementation; authoring-task dependencies are separate from shipping dependencies. Later phase implementations follow the agreed shipping chain and replace one hosted editor at a time.

The page is `/campaigns/<id>/week?phase=upkeep|activity|event|persistent|summary`. Consume the shell's existing legacy redirect `/canonical-workspace?campaign=X&phase=Y` and do not introduce another editor. Reference links target `/militia`, `/characters`, `/history` within the same campaign; no-militia targets `/setup`. The confirmed-week notice adds `?week=N` to history, using the shell's already-supported existing-history selection adapter. Preserve reload/Back/Forward and campaign/phase context through old bookmarks.

At delivery keep the current `UpkeepView`, `ActivityView`, `EventView`, `PersistentView`, `SummaryView` and their validators/writes mounted through the frame. Only one phase editor is mounted at a time; compute other phase facts without hidden duplicate editors/subscriptions. The current Summary still renders its existing required list, stale-review recovery, baseline/final, exceptions, adjustments, warnings and outcomes until Review & confirm replaces them. Frame amendments must not require that later implementation to make Confirmation usable now. Its final six-section layout and per-item Go links are a downstream handoff.

Reference History initially uses the existing reader; it cannot wait for rollout 11. Finished weeks may later replace the bounded adapter with its approved listing query. No old interaction is removed merely because a prototype lacks it. Remove each legacy phase view only in its owning rollout after every capability has an operable replacement.

### Published implementation handoffs

Implement after [Implement the campaign navigation shell and scoped routes](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/135). The next shipping area is [Implement rules-ordered Upkeep and compatible shared dice totals](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/140). The native dependencies between implementation issues encode this shipping order; authoring tasks are already complete.

Other referenced implementation contracts: [Implement shared Activity slots and action details](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/142), [Implement rules-ordered Event preparation and occurrence resolution](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/143), [Implement carried Persistent events and shared support decisions](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/144), [Implement Review & confirm with ordered consequences and exact reviewed Confirmation](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/145).

## 8. Shippable when

- The agreed stepper/rail/sheets, reference values/tabs/This phase and footer/strip work at all target sizes around every current editor, with source amendments applied and accessible controls/statuses.
- Readiness comes from the same optimistic draft and preview across all phases, remains distinct from warning and Confirmation eligibility, and respects fixed Persistent Phase Eligibility.
- Shared optimistic, saved, failed and remote feedback is correct; navigation remains local; departure safeguards and membership/campaign isolation hold through phase/section/campaign changes.
- Confirmation remains atomic, reviewed and stale-safe; retained week avoids the loading flash, every device transitions to Upkeep and gets the correct notice/history link, and delayed edits cannot affect the successor.
- Initial loading, retry, no-militia, access and maintenance states follow their separate owners' contracts. No future history query or other unapproved payload/rules change is required.
- All hosted capabilities remain reachable until their replacement owners ship. Inventory current locations/actual coverage are updated on implementation, including new WEEK-19 and shared handoffs; planned accounting alone is not marked shipped.
- Typecheck, lint and relevant tests pass, with actual affected browser/service-contract evidence reported. No prototype branch is merged.
