Implementation parent: [Militia UI rework](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/148) · Original planning map: [UI rework decisions](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/99) · Authoring task: [Write this area spec](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/125).

When creating implementation tickets from this spec, follow the [source traceability requirements](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/148#source-traceability-and-future-tickets): link back to this spec and carry forward the relevant decision-comment permalinks, amendments, pinned prototypes and capability IDs from the sections below.

## 1. Scope and ownership

Deliver **Upkeep, rollout position 3 of 12**, inside [Implement the shared Week frame and cross-device week transition](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/137) and the [campaign navigation shell](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/135). Replace the Upkeep main column with rules-ordered decisions, rolls and transfers. This is the implementation output of [Write the Upkeep implementation spec](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/125), outside the [Rework the militia UI for ease of use](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/99) planning map. Inspected application main: `eef41f7bad19e63ecce858e7a4490c937a4ece89`; the authoring branch adds inventory accounting only.

Own the approved **shared dice-total format and its compatibility across every current editor, resolver and stored-record reader in this delivery**, plus transfers without a character/officer restriction. Later [Activity](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/126), [Event](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/127), [Persistent](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/128), [Review & confirm](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/129) and [Finished weeks](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/133) designs consume that contract; their full layout redesigns are excluded. Team removal moves to the reachable existing Militia correction editor now, then to the [Militia corrections](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/131) Teams section. Character kind/manager/commandant changes remain [Characters & officers](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/132) ownership.

The frame owns navigation, all-phase readiness aggregation, This phase, save/remote-change feedback, confirmation locking and page states. Upkeep supplies accurate requirement/warning identities, section effects and accessible controls from the existing pure rule projections. No second draft store, hardcoded rule arithmetic in components, per-item confirmation, new GM role or claims/locks.

### Main-column acceptance

Show numbered sections **0 Team conditions → 1 Training attrition → 2 Maximum notoriety → 3 Treasury shortage → 4 Rank → 5 Deposits and withdrawals**. Headers report the calculated change or what is still needed. An inapplicable section is one muted line with its reason; an unresolved prerequisite must say it is waiting, rather than imply no effect. Required inputs, warnings and Rules Exception reasons sit under the affected item. The reference panel shows whole-week now → after values; section headers show this step's contribution, not duplicate whole-week totals.

- **First militia week:** show “Upkeep is skipped for the militia's first week”; expose “Skipped · first week” to the frame. Do not demand hidden team, roll, boon or transfer decisions or apply skipped Upkeep effects. Use fixed week-start context, not the displayed week number.
- **Team conditions:** each disabled team offers Recover / Leave disabled as choice cards. Selecting Recover saves the decision immediately at the rules cost. Prefill the minimum treasury from current rules, display/enter gp, show the corresponding treasury Table Adjustment with its required reason for a changed cost, and provide **Use rules cost**. Valid cost/reason edits save automatically; remove Stage recovery. While a changed value has no reason or is structurally invalid, retain it locally with field errors and retain the last valid shared decision; do not send a malformed partial adjustment or silently discard the local entry. Leave disabled clears that team's recovery adjustment through the existing edit contract.
- Recovery price differences remain the existing **post-baseline Table Adjustment**, not a change to how the Rules Baseline computes recovery, funds requirements or shortage. Show baseline treasury after recovery and the named final adjustment distinctly. Do not import the prototype's simplified accounting if it makes the adjusted price alter earlier rule checks.
- A missing team is a compact name/type/tier row with Security DC 15, raw d20, calculated bonus, total, modifier breakdown and its result: returns at **end of week**, stays missing, or natural 1 loses the team. A returning team remains unavailable to this week's Activity. Existing queued-return effects suppress the roll when the rules say so; show the scheduled return information instead of asking for an unnecessary check. No Recover/Leave/Remove choice for missing teams.
- **Training attrition:** Loyalty DC 10 followed, once that check is present, by 1d6 on success/natural 20 or 2d4 on failure with rank added by the rules. Natural 20 gains training; ordinary success loses training. Keep natural-roll behavior separate from modified total. Enter only the dice total, never rank/bonuses a second time.
- **Maximum notoriety:** at the applicable threshold show 1d20 + rank training loss, Loyalty DC 15, and Nearest settlement cards; settlement becomes required after a failed check. Below the threshold collapse the step and hide its settlement picker. Use rule facts for applicability, reputation floors, queued modifiers and losses; keep retained now-inapplicable inputs inert rather than using their presence to force the step open.
- **Treasury shortage:** below the rules minimum after baseline recovery, show that treasury and minimum plus the 2d4 + rank loss roll. Later deposits do not retroactively avoid the earlier shortage. Derive from rules-order intermediate facts, not the whole-week Final treasury.
- **Rank:** wait for required earlier decisions; then show the actual rank transition or unchanged rank and training threshold. Preserve multiple rank gains, highest-PC-level warning/cap, every boon and acknowledgement. For a title with a fixed feat list, each eligible PC chooses a card; Captain offers Great Fortitude, Iron Will, Lightning Reflexes. Tapping the selected card clears that choice. Gift/Skilled/XP and other open outcomes retain text and clear behavior. Store outcomes through existing text acknowledgements and stable subjects/IDs; no character feat schema, new PC record fields or loss of existing free-text acknowledgements. Previously recorded text outside the fixed options remains visible and editable as a legacy outcome until deliberately replaced/cleared.
- **Transfers:** list Deposit/Withdrawal and amount with accessible Remove transfer controls, then Deposit / Withdraw toggle, amount in gp and **Add**. No character choice or officer requirement. The section header shows treasury before/after ordered transfers, including applicable existing effects such as Theft; name related Table Adjustments under the list without applying them twice. Keep withdrawal-beyond-funds warning, Rules Exception reason and remove/clear operations. Adding one transfer stages a Weekly Draft edit; only whole-week Confirmation commits it.
- Keep archived-officer warnings when existing officer/check facts produce them: removing transfer ownership does not remove officer bonus diagnostics. Keep rank-cap, recovery-funds, changed-cost, withdrawal-funds, dice-range and other applicable warnings inline and in This phase. Do not recreate the retired transfer-officer warning under another name.

## 2. Decision sources

Later approved amendments override mock behavior. Acceptance is derived from these decisions, not from merging a prototype:

- [Upkeep: approved rules-order variant, totals, characterless transfers and signed-off removals](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/107#issuecomment-5836751035).
- [Shared Week layout](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/101#issuecomment-5831260876), as concretized by the [Week frame implementation contract](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/137).
- [Shared loading, unavailable, failed and maintenance states](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/119#issuecomment-5846266381).
- [Phone/desktop variant B and phase layout requirements](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/120#issuecomment-5846493929).
- [Separate Militia corrections and staged-reference warning obligations](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/103#issuecomment-5834024251).
- [Twelve-spec rollout, payload ownership and Ruleset Version amendment](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/122#issuecomment-5846600504).

Rules sources: `docs/ai/ironfang-militia/militia-rules.md` (Team Conditions and Upkeep), `militia-tables.md` (rank thresholds/minimum treasury/boons), and `CONTEXT.md` for Weekly Draft, Rules Baseline, Table Adjustment, Confirmation and immutable Resolution Record. The approved removal of the officer-only transfer rule is an explicit departure from the corpus's Step 5 sentence; update the executable rule behavior and document that intentional exception, without rewriting historical records or implying the source book changed.

## 3. Prototypes

| Purpose | Pinned snapshot | Approved route/variant |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Upkeep main column | [`prototype/upkeep` at `9c91ed3ba2503d55862b9aa89d54e23dcf884bd8`](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/tree/9c91ed3ba2503d55862b9aa89d54e23dcf884bd8) | `/prototype/upkeep?variant=A`, **Rules order**. Read `src/components/upkeep-prototype/{variant-a,parts,mock}.tsx` as layout reference. |
| Responsive shell/phase framing | [`prototype/responsive-shell` at `de10f4208904ca583d0fbc143bfc6314f0b9c0e7`](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/tree/de10f4208904ca583d0fbc143bfc6314f0b9c0e7) | `/prototype/responsive-shell?variant=B`; direct `/prototype/responsive-shell/screen?variant=B&phase=upkeep`. |

Both branches remain unmerged. Upkeep variants B–D and responsive A/C are rejected alternatives. Prototype controls, mock people/events, in-memory reducer and simplified calculations never ship. Differences required here: real permissions and saved data, every existing boon/queued effect, copper-exact gp input, baseline versus adjustment timing, compatibility repair for old staged data, all-phase roll readers, and complete loading/failure/access/confirmation behavior. Use the frame's approved final Summary-caption and phone maintenance positioning rather than copying older snapshot chrome.

## 4. Capability accounting

All rows are **planned** until implementation ships. Preserve stable IDs and update actual locations/test mappings on delivery.

| ID | Acceptance and coverage ownership |
| --- | --- |
| UPK-01 | Replace duplicate outcome tiles with section effects plus frame now → after values, retaining starting training/minimum treasury and rank visibility; Upkeep facts, frame presentation. |
| UPK-02 | First-week skip notice and frame “Skipped · first week” caption; skip has no hidden requirements/effects. |
| UPK-03 | All five existing required roll kinds, their conditional presence, notation/DC/bonus/total/modifiers and dice-total input; natural and loss branches tested. |
| UPK-04 | Nearest settlement cards only for applicable maximum-notoriety step; required after check failure; campaign-scoped choices and existing selection/clear semantics. |
| UPK-05 | Recover/Leave disabled and missing-team return rows; newly selecting Remove is retired here, with reachable Militia correction fallback and old-draft repair below. |
| UPK-06 | Rules-prefilled gp recovery cost, automatic valid edits, reasoned treasury adjustment, Use rules cost and Leave cleanup; Stage recovery retired. |
| UPK-07 | Return d20 plus Security bonus/total/result; scheduled-return suppression, end-week timing and natural 1 retained. |
| UPK-08 | All rank-boon details, per-PC fixed-list cards or text acknowledgement and clear; old text preserved. |
| UPK-09 | Inline recovery-funds and withdrawal-funds Rules Exceptions with reason/clear; new team-removal and non-officer-transfer exception entry retired from Upkeep, old recorded facts retained. |
| UPK-10 | Ordered deposit/withdraw Add/remove, gp display/copper persistence and before/after; officer choice retired. |
| UPK-11 | Applicable item warning messages and frame This phase/counts; removal/transfer-officer warnings retired for new ordinary editing, archived-officer bonus diagnostics retained. |
| UPK-12 | Required-decision/readiness facts feed frame footer/This phase and skip caption; no duplicate phase footer or contradictory local ready flag. |
| WEEK-04 | Shared roll/condition/transfer/exception/acknowledgement updates and latest edit wins; frame owns feedback. |
| WEEK-05 | Existing optimistic preview immediately updates section/header/reference/readiness facts. |
| WEEK-06 | Frame save/failed/remote-update feedback remains correct for new editors. |
| WEEK-07 | Rejected saves restore authoritative data and invalidate review; local invalid form entries are not falsely reported as saved. |
| WEEK-08 | Preserve frame departure protection and do not silently discard pending local invalid recovery/transfer entries on destructive form replacement; existing pending-write barrier remains authoritative. |
| WEEK-10 | All Upkeep editing and open input surfaces disabled during Confirmation; frame owns lifecycle. |
| WEEK-12 | Consume frame loading/failure/no-militia states and shell campaign gate; use section skeleton inside week frame while Upkeep content resolves. |
| WEEK-13 | Upkeep condition/settlement/boon choice cards keep tap/keyboard, clear where allowed and touch-safe existing drag affordances where still provided; no global removal of other owners' choice interactions. |
| WEEK-14 | Shared total input retains digits-only/invalid paste protection, zero, blank-clear and required-versus-format feedback; gp money fields use separate copper-exact decimal parser, not integer truncation. |
| WEEK-15 | Approved replacement of ordered per-die entry by one dice-total field; this owner delivers compatibility for all phase consumers and legacy arrays, including incomplete arrays and record readers. |
| WEEK-16 | Advisory total ranges based on required dice count/sides, legacy per-die diagnostics preserved; each phase's warning presentation remains reachable. |
| WEEK-17 | Upkeep numbered sections/check rows and forms fit phone/tablet/desktop; frame owns surrounding responsive shell. |
| WEEK-18 | Shared structured nested-roll adapter must support new totals and legacy forms without losing add/remove/Save/Clear, target, outcome or custom modifier operations; Activity/Event/Persistent/Review own their later layouts. |
| ACT-12 | Compatibility-only update to current Activity roll fields/modifier editor, including multi-die training/delivery; Activity owns full redesign. |
| ACT-13 | Activity check bonus/total remains unchanged for equivalent rolls; Activity owner retains final presentation. |
| EVT-01 | Event chance d100 dual-form input/read compatibility; Event owns full editor. |

| PER-04 | Nested Persistent checks support both forms and total entry without dropping officer/Overseer fields; Persistent owns redesign. |
| PER-07 | Equivalent Persistent check results/outcomes for both roll forms; Persistent owns final presentation. |
| PER-08 | Persistent roll requirements/range warnings remain available; Persistent owns full warnings/exception layout. |
| SUM-02 | Current Summary still identifies genuinely missing/incompatible rolls and withdrawal-funds reasons; Review & confirm owns presentation. |
| SUM-06 | Equivalent total rolls retain Rules Baseline/Final outcomes; only approved transfer rule changes behavior. Review & confirm owns presentation. |
| SUM-07 | Old exception facts remain readable/editable in existing Summary; no new officer-transfer requirement. Review & confirm owns final presentation. |
| SUM-09 | Current Summary renders applicable new range and transfer warnings; Review & confirm owns final list. |
| SUM-10 | Current consequences read actorless new transfers and equivalent dice totals; Review & confirm owns redesign. |
| SUM-11 | Existing text acknowledgements, including legacy boon outcomes, remain readable; Review & confirm owns presentation. |
| HIST-04 | Recorded Ruleset Version/provenance remain unchanged and readable; Finished weeks owns header redesign. |
| HIST-05 | Current historical record sections remain readable for old/new roll and transfer forms; Finished weeks owns replacement presentation. |
| STATE-01 | Shell maintenance stays readable; attempted Upkeep write follows existing failure path. |
| STATE-05 | Frame states plus shell membership/access state, with no Upkeep-specific access leakage. |

No new IDs required: total entry, check breakdown and changed transfer interaction replace or extend these existing capabilities. This issue does not claim all of Activity, Event, Persistent, Summary or historical layout as owned merely because it adapts a shared field.

**Signed-off removals/replacements:** [Upkeep approval](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/107#issuecomment-5836751035) explicitly covers UPK-05's Remove option, UPK-06's Stage recovery, UPK-09's team-removal and non-officer-transfer exception entry, UPK-10's officer choice, and corresponding UPK-11 removal/transfer-officer warnings. Team removal remains a correction capability. WEEK-15's ordered dice editing becomes one total per roll under the same approval and [shared ownership amendment](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/122#issuecomment-5846600504); historical dice detail is not retired. UPK-01 tiles and UPK-12 local hint relocate into headers/frame under the Upkeep and Week layout decisions. No archived-officer bonus diagnostic, withdrawal-funds exception, boon, modifier or historical fact is signed off for removal.

## 5. Data, payloads and rules

### Approved dice-total contract and compatibility

Today `src/lib/weekly-draft-facts.ts` uses one strict raw-roll object: `dice: number[]`, `sides`, `provenance`, `modifiers`. Upkeep and Activity require exact array lengths; Event/related checks access `dice[0]`. The same schema is nested in stored draft operations, canonical Resolution Record sources and structured Event/Persistent details. Replacing only Upkeep's inputs will break these consumers.

Implement an additive, unambiguous roll representation within the approved total change:

- Legacy form retains `dice`, `sides`, `provenance`, `modifiers` unchanged.
- New total form uses `diceTotal`, `diceCount`, `sides`, `provenance`, `modifiers`; it does not also contain `dice`. Both alternatives stay strict. `diceTotal` is a finite nonnegative safe whole number, `diceCount` a positive safe whole number, and existing sides/provenance/modifier structural constraints remain. Count/sides are the roll specification, not user-adjustable rule settings in ordinary roll controls.
- `diceTotal` is the **sum of dice only**; rank, organization bonuses, officers, selected one-use sources and entered modifiers remain separate and count once. For a required 2d4 the usual total range is 2–8; for 2d6 it is 2–12; for 1d20 it is 1–20. Out-of-range whole totals, including zero, save with advisory warnings. A wrong expected count/sides remains an incomplete/inapplicable input, not a range override.
- Normalization for calculation returns expected count, sides, dice total and the natural value for single-die rolls. A natural 1/20 is the unmodified one-die value in either form; a multi-die sum equal to 1/20 is never a natural d20 result. Preserve all original provenance and modifiers when editing the number.
- A complete legacy array displays its sum in the new field without rewriting on read, and produces exactly the same outcome and applicable legacy per-die warning as before. An incomplete old array remains incomplete, with a visible indication that its recorded dice need a complete total; do not sum partial input as if complete, fabricate missing dice, or cast `[total]` as two dice. Keep the original data until the player supplies/replaces/clears that roll. Branch changes recalculate the required specification without treating a stale differently specified roll as ready.
- Newly edited roll fields write the total alternative. Clearing deletes/nulls through the existing relevant edit operation and preserves clear semantics; never save NaN, an empty array as a valid total, or an invented zero. All current roll controls, including generic nested Event/Persistent rolls, must render/edit both forms by the end of this delivery. Their page layouts may remain old. Custom modifiers, officer/target choices, acknowledgement and structured list operations remain available.

The field names above concretize the already-approved dice-total payload, not a new endpoint or unrelated migration. Share a pure helper/adapter rather than adding phase-specific coercions. Complete this compatibility work before any new writer is enabled:

| Layer/consumer | Required work in this issue |
| --- | --- |
| `weekly-draft-facts.ts`, `weekly-draft-contract.ts`, `weekly-draft.ts` | Dual schema and all nested argument/edit variants; preserve IDs, optional/clear behavior and atomic recovery-adjustment edit. |
| `weekly-draft-persistence-contract.ts`, `weekly-draft-persistence.ts`, `weekly-draft-consistency.ts`, `weekly-confirmation-contract.ts`, `canonical-weekly-source.ts` | Both representations survive serialize/parse, optimistic replay, conflict targets, identity/fingerprint comparison, stale-review and confirmation requests without lossy normalization. Reads do not advance revision. |
| `rules-upkeep.ts`, `rules-activity.ts`, `rules-economy.ts` | Dice-total/count readiness, sum/range and natural-roll handling; cover Drill training and Special Order delivery, not just 2d4 Upkeep. Preserve effect and modifier timing. |
| `rules-event-selection.ts`, `rules-event-checks.ts`, `rules-event-shaping.ts`, event action helpers and persistent-event resolvers | Every direct dice/index read uses the dual-form semantics; percentile checks, event tables, reactive actions, nested officer/capture/mitigation/persistent checks remain equivalent. |
| `phase-view.ts`, `types.ts`, `upkeep-view.tsx`, `team-recovery.tsx`, `activity-details.tsx`, Event/Persistent facts/views and `structured-choice-field.tsx` | Dual read/single-total input, readiness, warning messages and nested roll handling. Refactor schema-shape assumptions such as `rawRollSchema.shape.modifiers` into shared common-field access rather than breaking modifier editors when raw roll becomes a union. |
| `summary-facts.ts`, `summary-messages.ts`, current Summary and `historical-week/{record-view,record-facts}.tsx` | Read/render new totals and old dice/transfer actors; absence of character is valid. Keep selected-record facts, old sources, adjudication and immutable results readable. |
| `canonical-resolution-record.ts`, `convex/lib/canonicalStorageValidators.ts`, canonical storage/persistence/confirmation/history paths and fixtures | Widen all embedded draft, initial-draft, operation/accepted-draft and record-source validators; preserve old records and operation replay. Current `canonicalHistory.read` must parse either form before Finished weeks redesign. |

Use `rg` across all source/test consumers of `.dice`, raw-roll schemas and transfers during implementation; this table identifies known seams, not permission to ignore another live reader. There is no eager backfill, record rewrite, new format-version field on the whole Weekly Draft, or schema removal in this scope. If deploying in stages, compatible readers/validators precede new writers; retain old writes/reads throughout the gradual editor rollout. No old page may misread an incoming new total as blank or crash. Historical display uses recorded results; it never resolves old records with today's engine.

### Approved transfers and rule behavior

New transfer payload: `{ transferId, direction: 'deposit' | 'withdraw', copper }`. Keep `transferId` because ordered list edits/removal/concurrency target it; “no character” does not authorize deleting transfer identity. Accept existing transfer objects with `characterId` for compatibility; retain that actor on old records and do not require an actor on new transfers. Preserve the existing direction/amount structural validation and transfer ordering.

Remove current-week transfer character membership/reference and officer checks from `rules-upkeep.ts`, `weekly-draft-references.ts`, phase facts, warning/exception derivation and new treasury change-plan entries. A legacy actor on an open draft is optional historical metadata for this purpose: an archived/removed actor must not keep the newly approved characterless transfer from resolving. Unrelated target references remain campaign-scoped and validated. New ledger entries omit actor; old ledger entries/record sources keep theirs. Stop creating/requiring `upkeep-transfer-officer`; preserve old saved exception facts in legacy records and current adjudication displays without making them newly required. Keep `upkeep-transfer-funds`, recovery funds rules, existing Theft behavior and all other resolution semantics.

**Ruleset Version:** the total format and gp presentation alone do not change Weekly Resolution behavior and need no bump. Removing the transfer character/officer restriction **does** change behavior. Increment `CANONICAL_WEEKLY_RULESET_VERSION` to the **next unused** number at implementation; inspected main is 5, so 6 is only the current candidate. Coordinate with Characters & officers and any intervening rules work; never hardcode a promised shared version. New confirmed records carry the version used; earlier immutable records retain their sources, actor/dice details, plans/outcomes and versions. New preview and server Confirmation must agree. Do not reconstruct old rules results from new projections.

### Money, recovery and legacy staged removal

Gp input is display conversion only: 1 gp = 100 copper. Accept decimal gp down to copper precision, including an existing 7-copper amount displayed as 0.07 gp. Parse decimal strings exactly into a safe integer copper amount, reject finer precision/invalid/overflow input with styled field errors, and never round away stored copper. Zero remains structurally permitted; empty differs from malformed. Use `react-hook-form`/`zod` and `noValidate`, with errors contained in their fields so neighboring controls do not misalign.

Keep the existing `upkeep_team` edit's atomic recovery adjustment, stable `upkeep-recovery:<teamId>` identity and delta `rulesCostCopper - enteredCostCopper`. A valid cost/reason auto-save uses the existing ordered mutation path; rapid local edits and remote updates cannot resurrect an older price/reason. No new debounce endpoint or save button is necessary.

Do not remove the stored `remove` enum, its resolver or old removal exception parser: the approval removes the new Upkeep choice, not historical compatibility. If an open draft already contains Remove, show the retained decision/reason and a compatibility repair action that clears it through the existing nullable `upkeep_team` edit, with a link to Militia corrections. Never silently delete/confirm a hidden removal or invent a replacement team decision. Existing completed legacy choices retain their semantics until explicitly cleared; unmet legacy removal reasons remain visible as blockers with clear repair. The correction editor must warn about affected staged choices; clear affected draft references before submitting a removal when required by the current backend. Do not broaden correction/backend acceptance to save unrelated edits around orphaned references.

No other schema/argument/result or rule change is approved here. In particular no character-kind migration, `remove_slot`, history listing query, new confirmation policy or change to Table Adjustment timing. Any additional such change requires the map's explicit human approval before it joins this scope.

## 6. Validation and coverage

Keep every existing E2E journey with equivalent assertions. Rewrite **Stage transfer → Add**, officer-select removal, copper-field locators → gp, and outcome-tile locators → named section/reference values; retain the actual treasury, validation and cross-device assertions. Replace per-die entry assertions with total-entry plus explicit legacy compatibility tests, not weaker completion-only checks.

| Existing coverage | Required retained/revised behavior |
| --- | --- |
| `e2e/canonical-workspace.spec.ts` | Shared Upkeep edits, digits/invalid paste/zero/blank, range advisory, deposit validation/result, rejected save/recovery, independent phase navigation while saving, pending departure, tap/keyboard/touch card operation, cross-device week transition and responsive geometry. Rewrite old settlement-card exercise to an applicable maximum-notoriety failed check. |
| `e2e/support/activity-workspace.ts`, `event-workspace.ts`, `persistent-workspace.ts`, `persistent-qa.ts`, `summary-qa.ts` | Adapt roll helpers to one total and preserve every action/mitigation/persistent/modifier/outcome/exception/adjustment scenario under the still-old page layouts. |
| `e2e/complete-week.spec.ts`, `canonical-confirmation.spec.ts` | Complete and confirm week, exact reviewed source, rules version and outcome, immutable history, concurrent/stale review, delayed old-draft writes and successor transition. |
| `e2e/canonical-persistence.spec.ts` | Existing direct Convex auth/isolation, operation replay, rollback and dropped acknowledgements remain required; extend with both roll forms and both transfer forms. |
| `e2e/realtime-action-slot.spec.ts`, `character-ledger.spec.ts`, `existing-militia.spec.ts`, `access.spec.ts`, `canonical-cutover.spec.ts` and setup/nightly helpers | Preserve unrelated shared choices, setup, corrections, access, reload/cutover and retired-path rejection. Do not delete scenarios because their old locators moved. |

Add focused behavioral/contract cases:

1. First-week skip, ordinary attrition success/failure/natural 20, notoriety below/at threshold and failed/successful settlement check, shortage after recovery but before transfers, queued loss modifiers, multiple rank gains and text/fixed-list/clear boon acknowledgements. No totals/headers imply a final result while prerequisite facts are missing.
2. Recover versus Leave; default gp cost; changed cost requires reason; live valid save, rapid edits, rollback, Use rules cost and removal of adjustment; baseline shortage unaffected by post-baseline adjustment. Missing team natural 1, DC success/failure and scheduled-return no-roll; returning team cannot act until next week. Existing staged Remove remains visible and clearable, corrections remain reachable, orphan repair works.
3. Dice-total equivalence for **every applicable roll family**: 1d20, d100, 1d4/1d6 and 2d4/2d6 including nested rolls. Legacy full arrays retain outcomes/modifiers/provenance; partial arrays stay incomplete; wrong count/sides do not become ready; natural values use raw single-die results; ordinary out-of-range totals save with warnings. No duplicate calculated/custom/one-use bonuses. Test old-array/new-total mixed drafts and old/new record sources.
4. Characterless deposits and withdrawals with no roster/officers; zero and fractional-gp-to-copper round trips; withdrawal beyond funds still needs the existing reasoned exception; ordered multiple transfers and Theft remain correct. Legacy transfer actor absent from current roster no longer blocks new resolution, while old actor-bearing records remain unchanged/readable.
5. Two members simultaneously edit the same roll, recovery amount/reason and transfer list; latest accepted edit wins with one optimistic store, no lost list entries and correct pending/rejected feedback. A member on the old Activity/Event/Persistent layout receives and edits a new total correctly. Reload retains every accepted value. Editing while another player reviews invalidates stale Confirmation; confirmation locks all Upkeep controls.
6. A foreign organization/non-member cannot read/write, spoof campaign references, or reuse a draft/transfer ID from another campaign. Every backend path enforces membership; UI gating never substitutes for it. Existing server maintenance failure restores last saved values and the frame remains readable.
7. History parses an older record with individual dice, actor-bearing transfers and old exception facts without changing source/adjudication equality, versions or plans; a new record displays totals and characterless transfers. Reading either makes no writes and never consults today's militia for its result. Keep audit pagination/navigation and effective-record selection unchanged.

Extend relevant existing `rules-upkeep*.test.ts`, `rules-activity*`, `rules-economy*`, event/persistent rule suites, weekly draft/persistence/confirmation tests, canonical storage/preview/history integration suites, and Upkeep/phase/structured-field/historical component tests. Assert client/server preview equality with both representations and failure boundaries. Test at phone 390×844 and landscape, tablet 1180×820 with panel open/closed, and desktop 1440×900; fields/errors and long names fit without horizontal page scroll or controls hidden under fixed bars. Keyboard/screen-reader names identify each roll/team/amount and announce required/range/save messages.

Run `pnpm -s typecheck`, `pnpm -s lint` and relevant unit/integration tests, then affected E2E journeys through the repository's declared isolated-preview harness. Preserve required-result gates and report actual execution/service limitations; unrun live tests are not passed tests. Spec authoring itself does not deploy or run UI tests.

## 7. Routes and rollout

Live destination remains `/campaigns/<id>/week?phase=upkeep`. Consume shell preservation of `/canonical-workspace?campaign=<id>&phase=upkeep` and frame phase URL/Back/Forward handling. No new Upkeep route, redirect or campaign selector. Phase navigation is local and never writes to another player's Phase View.

Native implementation dependency: **this issue is blocked by the Week frame implementation issue**. Activity's output must be natively blocked by this issue, then Event → Persistent → Review & confirm and the remaining approved chain. Authoring task dependencies are distinct and do not substitute for those shipping edges.

Ship compatibility validators, readers, derivations and minimally adapted current phase/history controls together with or before Upkeep's new writers; later redesigns cannot be prerequisites for reading totals. Keep old roll/transfer forms accepted. Do not remove legacy historical parsing after the redesigned pages ship. Keep current Summary/Confirmation and history browsing fully functional until their owners replace them.

At Upkeep cutover, team removal is reachable at `/campaigns/<id>/militia` through the existing correction form. Remove that fallback only when redesigned Teams corrections cover remove/reason/validation/staged-reference repair and realtime behavior. Leave roster/officer correction access intact until Characters & officers ships. None of these fallbacks requires merging a prototype.

### Published implementation handoffs

Implement after [Implement the shared Week frame and cross-device week transition](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/137). The next shipping area is [Implement shared Activity slots and action details](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/142). The native dependencies between implementation issues encode this shipping order; authoring tasks are already complete.

Other referenced implementation contracts: [Implement rules-ordered Event preparation and occurrence resolution](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/143), [Implement carried Persistent events and shared support decisions](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/144), [Implement Review & confirm with ordered consequences and exact reviewed Confirmation](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/145), [Implement in-place Militia corrections and reference repair](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/139), [Implement Characters & officers with role corrections and compatible kind migration](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/141), [Implement Finished weeks with immutable records and paged audit history](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/146).

## 8. Shippable when

- All twelve UPK capabilities and enumerated shared obligations are implemented or explicitly replaced under their cited approvals; no hidden legacy decision prevents a player from finishing/repairing the week.
- Upkeep is rules-ordered and concise, conditional steps explain why they do not apply, first-week skip is correct, checks show raw total/bonus/result, team recovery and boon decisions are shared, and new transfers have no character restriction.
- Every current phase and Summary/history reader works with new totals and old complete/partial arrays; nested fields and modifiers remain usable. Existing actor/dice history is immutable and readable. Canonical persistence/replay/Confirmation contracts remain intact.
- The intentional transfer rule change uses the next unused Ruleset Version and matching server/client behavior; format-only conversion does not pretend to change old outcomes. No unrelated payload changes or migrated officer mechanics.
- Tablet main-column layout fits the frame; phone headers wrap effects and roll labels use full width; conditions/boon/settlement cards and form rows wrap or stack accessibly. Desktop content scrolls in the frame's center column. Preserve fonts/theme/shadcn components and accessible card/input/save feedback. Errors remain inside their field containers and all controls stay reachable with mobile keyboard and fixed bars.
- Loading uses the frame/section skeleton with accessible status; page failure uses **The week could not be loaded. / Try again** with usable shell; no militia has **Set up militia**; campaign access and maintenance use their shell owner, and first-week/no-recovery/non-applicable sections have honest empty states.
- Existing corrections supply team removal until the new Militia page ships; no broken campaign/phase bookmarks or inaccessible current editor.
- Inventory current locations, planned-to-shipped state and concrete test coverage are updated. `pnpm -s typecheck`, `pnpm -s lint` and relevant checks pass, with real E2E evidence and any environmental limits recorded.

body:
Implementation parent: [Militia UI rework](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/148) · Original planning map: [UI rework decisions](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/99) · Authoring task: [Write this area spec](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/126).

When creating implementation tickets from this spec, follow the [source traceability requirements](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/148#source-traceability-and-future-tickets): link back to this spec and carry forward the relevant decision-comment permalinks, amendments, pinned prototypes and capability IDs from the sections below.

## 1. Scope and ownership

Deliver **Activity, rollout position 4 of 12**, after [rules-ordered Upkeep and compatible shared dice totals](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/140), inside the [Week frame](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/137) and [campaign navigation shell](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/135). This implementation issue is the output of [Write the Activity implementation spec](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/126), outside the [UI planning map](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/99). Application main inspected: `eef41f7bad19e63ecce858e7a4490c937a4ece89`.

Own the Action Slot board, action-card picker, selected-choice details, team context, operating settlement, Helpful/modifier controls and the approved empty-extra-slot removal edit. Preserve every existing Staged Action Choice and its action-specific fields. Slots are shared and have no claims/locks; local selection and open sheets never control another player's Phase View. Only whole-week Confirmation commits the prepared week.

Frame owns phase navigation/readiness aggregation, This phase, reference values, shared save/recovery/remote-update feedback and Confirmation lifecycle. Upkeep owns the shared roll representation, adapters and old/new compatibility. [Event authoring](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/127) owns event occurrence/candidate resolution, mitigation and reactive Sabotage; keep its current controls usable throughout. [Militia corrections](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/139) owns Teams/manager corrections and complete source-restoration recovery. [Characters & officers](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/141) owns the later kind/manager/commandant migration across this and all other consumers. Those later page deliveries are not prerequisites for Activity.

### Main-column acceptance

- Header: occupied/allowed count with real rank/Strategist/other allowance contributions as plain text, **Add slot**, and compact **Operating from** settlement selector. Do not hardcode the prototype's rank/count. Empty slots are not occupied actions. An allowance reduction retains excess slots and choices with warnings; never discard them.
- Tablet board: one row of numbered cards showing action, team and Ready / decisions remaining / warning count. A divider marks the allowance boundary, with an amber border and textual indication on excess slots. Show **Strategist +2** on the slot identified by existing rules. Preserve rule ordering: earlier choices that change officers can affect subsequent allowances/bonuses. Do not calculate the bonus from a locally selected officer or simply the last occupied card.
- Tap an empty slot to open a bottom picker sheet, grouped **A ready team can take these**, **No team needed**, **No ready team (needs a Rules Exception)**. Render every existing Activity action as a playing card. Derive grouping from current actor eligibility, team availability and rules; a group is guidance, not a hard filter. A tap stages the action and closes the picker; closing/Escape cancels without editing.
- Tap an occupied slot to show its details **below the board**, with **Change action**, **Move to…** and **Clear <action>**. Change action opens the picker and uses existing replacement semantics. Move to moves the complete choice into an empty slot or swaps with an occupied slot, preserving choice identity, team, rolls, exceptions, acknowledgements, receipts and nested entities under existing semantics. Recalculate position-dependent rules afterwards. There is no standing action deck, team strip, Activity drag or drag-out deletion.
- Show **Remove Action Slot N** only for an empty slot beyond the allowance; removing a slot is distinct from clearing its choice. Any player may use it; there is no creator restriction. Clearing an occupied extra slot leaves the empty slot until explicitly removed.
- Team is an accessible dropdown: eligible teams first, divider, **Other teams**, and **No team** to clear. Show type/tier and Free / Acts in Action Slot N / Disabled / Missing. Ineligible, used, disabled and missing teams remain selectable with their current rules warnings/Rules Exception requirements. Include existing and staged-reference options when current rules support them. Eligibility must account for prior actions and Upkeep recovery/return timing rather than mark every source team ready.
- Checks show the required dice-total input, calculated bonus, total and a readable breakdown of rank/focus, officers, Strategist, Helpful and other modifiers. Use Upkeep's shared total control for every roll, including Drill training and Special Order delivery. Do not fold bonus into the entered dice total.
- At a Helpful operating settlement show **Use Helpful +2 (<settlement>, once per Activity)** for applicable Loyalty/Secrecy/Security checks. Show where it is currently used and let tapping move it to this check. Retain the existing `helpful` source and once-per-Activity rules. **+ Modifier** opens available-bonus/custom choices; custom value and required reason use styled fields. Added modifiers show signed value, label, reason where applicable, and accessible remove. Keep automatic modifiers explanatory and avoid adding them twice. Existing nonstandard sources, inactive bonuses, duplicate Helpful selections or now-inapplicable modifiers remain visible with warnings and repair controls until explicitly changed; a changed settlement must not silently erase their recorded facts.
- Preserve calculated versus entered cost, every action's own warnings/readiness, Rules Exception reason/remove, outcomes and receipts. Deterministic numeric defaults come from current pure rule helpers and remain overridable; an explicit staged value, including zero, wins over a new default. Warnings are advisory and rule-exception requirements retain their current meaning; structural validity, references and existing Confirmation requirements still apply.
- Operating from remains a nullable campaign settlement choice in Activity. It supplies Helpful eligibility and the **Event chance-roll** reputation modifier already shipped in [Fix Event settlement reputation modifier](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/pull/115); the older Activity decision/prototype's event-table wording is superseded. It is distinct from an action's target settlement and Upkeep's Nearest settlement.

## 2. Decision sources

Read linked full discussions; later approvals override old prototype behavior:

- [Activity variant E and approved remove_slot](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/106#issuecomment-5835792948).
- [Touch-card research and accessibility findings](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/104#issuecomment-5822359665).
- [Week main-column/shared-frame boundary](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/101#issuecomment-5831260876), implemented by the Week frame contract above.
- [Officer behavior and later manager/kind change](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/112#issuecomment-5836835106), subject to the [rollout/version amendment](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/122#issuecomment-5846600504).
- [Phone/desktop variant B](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/120#issuecomment-5846493929) and [shared states](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/119#issuecomment-5846266381).
- [Corrections and affected-draft references](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/103#issuecomment-5834024251), concretized in Militia corrections above.
- [Shared dice-total approval](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/107#issuecomment-5836751035), concretized in Upkeep above, and [twelve-spec completion gate](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/122#issuecomment-5846600504).

Use `CONTEXT.md` vocabulary. Rule authority is `docs/ai/ironfang-militia/militia-tables.md` for numbers and `militia-rules.md` for Activity/action/team/officer semantics. This is a presentation/editing change, not permission to rewrite action resolution.

## 3. Prototypes

| Branch and pinned snapshot | Approved route/variant | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`prototype/activity-slots` at `eea4ac70b0d85d784ccefda5337b4506a33dae57`](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/tree/eea4ac70b0d85d784ccefda5337b4506a33dae57) | `/prototype/activity-slots?variant=E` — **Chosen: slot board + picker sheet** | Tablet board, grouped picker, details, team/modifier controls. A–D are alternatives, not deliverables. |
| [`prototype/responsive-shell` at `de10f4208904ca583d0fbc143bfc6314f0b9c0e7`](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/tree/de10f4208904ca583d0fbc143bfc6314f0b9c0e7) | `/prototype/responsive-shell?variant=B`; direct `/prototype/responsive-shell/screen?variant=B&phase=activity` | Phone and desktop arrangement inside the shell/frame. |

Keep branches unmerged. Implement with current shadcn/ui, fonts/theme and focused controllers/service hooks/pure rules; no mock reducer, hardcoded team eligibility, example totals, variant switcher or prototype data. Approved differences include shared dice totals, shipped Event chance correction, every field omitted by the mock, missing-reference compatibility, actual server save/failure states and current rule-derived allowances. Do not copy later prototype PC/NPC values into today's contracts.

## 4. Capability accounting

All accounting below is **planned** until implementation ships. Preserve existing inventory IDs and then update actual component locations and test mappings.

| ID | Acceptance/coverage owned here |
| --- | --- |
| ACT-01 | All 23 actions remain selectable as cards in the grouped picker, including actions with no eligible team. |
| ACT-02 | Empty-slot → card placement, Change action replacement and closing-sheet cancel replace deck-first placement. |
| ACT-03 | Approved retirement of Activity deck drag; equivalent touch/keyboard placement is ACT-02. |
| ACT-04 | Move to preserves the entire choice and identity across empty-slot moves. |
| ACT-05 | Move to swaps occupied choices with their details. |
| ACT-06 | Clear <action> remains; drag-out and global Clear selected choice controls are replaced by selected details. |
| ACT-07 | Placement/stale-choice/failed-save feedback uses the frame's shared status, never falsely reports acceptance. |
| ACT-08 | Add slot retains existing stable-ID edit and immediate shared visibility. |
| ACT-09 | Real allowance explanation, Strategist badge, excess boundary/amber/text warning and readiness. |
| ACT-10 | All common/action-specific fields and structured operations listed below, with eligible-first team dropdown; target/mode choices retain current card controls. |
| ACT-11 | Rules-derived calculated cost and entered override/advisory mismatch retained without overwriting explicit values. |
| ACT-12 | All required rolls use shared totals; Helpful inline and available/custom modifiers through + Modifier replace Sources and modifiers accordion. No modifier capability removed. |
| ACT-13 | Equivalent bonus, total and full modifier breakdown from pure rules projection. |
| ACT-14 | Every required outcome acknowledgement and clear operation, including retained legacy text. |
| ACT-15 | Special Order received day/receipt notes, record/clear and order/acknowledgement identity preserved. |
| ACT-16 | All applicable per-choice Rules Exception reasons and removal; retained old reasons remain visible. |
| ACT-17 | All existing warnings/preparation requirements in details, slot counts, and frame This phase. |
| ACT-18 | Nullable Operating from selection; Helpful and Event chance consequences; missing-settlement recovery. |
| **ACT-19 (new)** | Remove an empty extra Action Slot, enforced server-side under authoritative allowance, including concurrent edits/removal. |
| WEEK-04 | Every Activity edit is shared; two players may edit any slot; no claims/locks. |
| WEEK-05 | Existing optimistic preview updates choice/header/reference/readiness facts immediately. |
| WEEK-06 | Integrate frame-owned saving/saved/failure/remote-update feedback for picker, details, modifiers and slot edits. |
| WEEK-07 | Failed/stale saves reconcile authoritative values and invalidate review; frame/store owns recovery lifecycle. |
| WEEK-08 | Frame departure guard covers pending edits; don't silently discard invalid local detail/modifier entries when replacing their editor. |
| WEEK-10 | All mutation controls, including already-open sheets and menus, honor frame Confirmation disabling and old-draft identity guards. |
| WEEK-12 | Activity supplies its skeleton/empty picker/empty slots/detail states within frame loading/failure/no-militia and shell access gates. |
| WEEK-13 | Activity picker cards use tap/keyboard with real selected/focus semantics and touch scrolling; the ACT-03 retirement does not remove other phases' choice-card drag or nested existing choice capabilities. |
| WEEK-14 | Preserve numeric zero/clear/invalid-paste and required-versus-format behavior; use signed numeric validation for custom modifiers, not a nonnegative-only stepper. |
| WEEK-15 | Consume Upkeep-owned complete/incomplete legacy-array and new-total adapter; no second format or migration. |
| WEEK-16 | Advisory ranges and legacy per-die diagnostics remain visible; malformed/count/sides mismatches are not silently accepted as complete. |
| WEEK-17 | Own Activity phone/tablet/desktop layouts; shell/frame own surrounding navigation and reference controls. |
| WEEK-18 | Preserve nested/list/discriminated fields, source/target picks and add/remove/Save/Clear; Event/Persistent/Review retain ownership of their corresponding fields. |
| NAV-15 | Shell owns scoped phase routing/redirects; Activity preserves `phase=activity`, reload and Back/Forward. |
| STATE-01 | Consume shell maintenance notice and normal rejected-write feedback while keeping data readable. |
| STATE-05 | Consume frame/shell load, failure, no-militia and access states with no protected-data flash. |
| STATE-06 | Reload/second-device persistence of all edits and retained legacy values; shared obligation. |
| EVT-04, EVT-06 | Shared boundary: retain Activity candidate trees/selections and Event markers without losing identity; Event owns occurrence display/selection redesign. |
| LEDG-01 | Shared boundary: existing corrections remain reachable for team/reference repairs; Militia corrections owns final section editor and full restoration. |

Signed-off replacements: [Activity approval](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/106#issuecomment-5835792948) replaces ACT-01 deck, ACT-02 deck-first gestures, ACT-03 drag, ACT-04/05 drag alternatives, ACT-06 drag-out/global clear, ACT-07 standalone placement line, ACT-10 embedded detail/team-card arrangement and ACT-12 Sources and modifiers accordion with the controls above. Only ACT-03 retires as a standalone capability; the others preserve the underlying operation. The same approval adds ACT-19. WEEK-15 ordered-die replacement belongs to Upkeep's existing signed-off contract. No action, field, roll, reference, exception, receipt or acknowledgement is signed off for removal.

## 5. Data, payloads and rules

### Existing choice fields: exhaustive delivery checklist

Use `stagedActionChoiceSchema`, existing rule requirements, `activity-input-options.ts`, `activity-details.tsx` and their tests as the current contract. Keep partial drafts legal; a required-for-resolution field may be empty while preparing. Never reconstruct a choice from just the fields present in the prototype. Common fields are stable choice/team identities, entered cost, all rolls with provenance/modifiers, consumables and acknowledgements; exception identity/reasons remain in their existing draft collection.

| Action | Fields/operations beyond common fields that must remain |
| --- | --- |
| Activate Black Market; Broker Market | Target settlement; purchases with item identity/name/price/weight; sales item selection; nested add/remove/Save/Clear. |
| Activate Refuge; Reduce Danger | Target settlement. |
| Change Officer Role | Character, from-role and to-role; six existing roles. Stages a weekly action; never becomes an immediate officer correction. |
| Covert Action | Augment/contact/cache mode, following-choice reference and location. |
| Dismiss Team | Target team. |
| Drill Militia; Earn Gold; Lie Low | Full common fields and action-dependent checks/training rolls/outcomes. Lie Low exclusivity and one Drill per Activity remain rules-driven. |
| Gather Information; Knowledge Check | Subject and required outcomes/checks. |
| Guarantee Event; Manipulate Events | Complete candidate event trees and selected candidate, including existing nested fields, parents, origins, rolls, targets and outcomes. Preserve existing structured controls now; Event later supplies its dedicated presentation. |
| Recruit Team | Team type and conditional recruitment-check kind/DC for exception-enabled recruitment. Preserve any existing representable actor/manager context; do not invent a new manager property on this action. |
| Rescue Character | Character, level, destination discriminant (headquarters/refuge), refuge settlement. |
| Restore Character | Character/level; ability damage, hit points, restorative effect, break enchantment, raise dead, restoration, stone to flesh modes; effect, effect level, target present. |
| Secure Cache | Place/retrieve, existing/new cache identity, class, item references, nested purchases, settlement, extradimensional, location, secure. |
| Special | Instruction. |
| Special Order | Name, decimal weight, order/item identity, settlement, purchase/enchantment mode, price, expedited, ordered day; receipt received day/acknowledgement and notes; required delivery rolls. |
| Spread Propaganda | Settlement, possible and occupied booleans. |
| Strike Team | Support/extraction and location. |
| Upgrade Team | Target team and destination team type. |

Preserve staged-produced item/cache/team options and generate identities once per new entity, not on every render. Keep retained values visible when a changed mode/action prerequisite makes a field temporarily inapplicable; expose intentional clear/replacement through existing valid edits. Changing action uses current replacement cleanup semantics rather than copying incompatible fields. Generic nested officer/Overseer/Strategist/event/consumable selectors remain wherever the existing schema requires them. **Sabotage is Event-reactive, not a new Activity deck card.**

### Only new edit: remove_slot

Add `{ kind: 'remove_slot', slotId }` to the existing Weekly Draft edit union. No new table, slot-origin/owner flag, batch endpoint, query/result property or changed public mutation signature beyond that approved edit alternative.

The existing slot's current position must be **beyond the rules-derived allowance and its choice must be null**, both checked on the server against the authoritative campaign source/current open draft when the edit is accepted. A client-provided allowance is not authoritative. Current `projectActivity().slots[].overAllowance` is false for empty slots, so it cannot be reused as the removal predicate. Extract/reuse pure capacity/position facts consistent with sequential Activity resolution, including rank, officer changes, queued/persistent modifiers and incomplete earlier steps. If the authoritative prerequisite facts are unavailable, removal must not guess that a slot is extra. Do not change allowance or action-capacity exception policy here.

Update `weekly-draft-contract.ts`, the pure edit reducer, `weekly-draft-consistency.ts` targets/rebasing, optimistic persistence, server `canonicalDraftPersistence` authority and the embedded operation validators/replay readers together. Check the latest pre-edit slot and allowance, not only a retained base revision. Remove by stable slot ID; later slots retain their IDs and choices as numbering changes. Preserve operation deduplication and old-draft rejection. Unknown/already-removed slot, newly occupied slot, newly in-allowance slot and stale/delayed operation take existing rejection/reconciliation paths; never remove another card by its new array index. Existing records/drafts/operation forms remain readable; there is no data backfill.

### Roll, modifier and reference compatibility

Inherit [Upkeep's exact shared contract](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/140): legacy `{ dice, sides, provenance, modifiers }` and new `{ diceTotal, diceCount, sides, provenance, modifiers }`, strict alternatives, shared normalization and unchanged natural single-die behavior. New number edits write totals; read-only visits never rewrite old dice. Complete arrays display their sum; partial arrays remain incomplete; changing a roll's required count/sides does not make an old roll valid by coercion. Clearing preserves existing semantics and no hidden default zero appears. All modifiers/provenance and recorded immutable outcomes survive.

Helpful relocation and modifier operations use existing detail edits/source values. The current public API has no multi-edit atomic operation: when relocation requires several writes, clear existing Helpful applications before setting the selected target through the existing ordered edit pipeline, retaining each choice's unrelated fields. Do not claim success until accepted, allow Confirmation during pending work, or present an intermediate state as a completed move. Failure reconciles the accepted state and offers retry; refresh current choices before continuing after remote edits. Test two devices moving Helpful concurrently and preserve existing duplicate-source warnings/repair rather than inventing a backend lock or silently changing the resolver's once-per-Activity rule. Other available bonuses retain their current usage/consumption constraints. Unknown/legacy modifiers can be seen and removed; a custom modifier requires a signed valid value and nonblank reason.

Show missing-reference labels contextually (for example missing target team on Action Slot N), without opaque IDs or fabricated names. Existing staged references must not disappear because a selector no longer has an option. Expose clear/replace/repair using current operations, and preserve failure feedback. The server checks the **whole resulting draft** for references: one edit can repair only when its resulting draft has no remaining orphan. Never promise that clearing one of several orphaned slots or saving an unrelated detail will work. Before redesigned corrections ships, link to the shell-hosted existing correction editor and keep affected choices visible; Militia corrections owns the complete tested same-identity source-restoration workflow for multiple orphans in its later delivery. After that delivery, integrate its named source-repair entry points; do not add an archive query, raw-ID field, broad reference bypass or silently deleted choices here.

### Later rules migration and versions

Retain current character/roster kinds and manager limits until Characters & officers ships. That owner must update this page's affected actor/manager options, capacity warnings and Rules Exception handling alongside its `pc | npc` migration, mirrored roster kind, role-based manager limits and commandant Hit Dice fallback. Team-manager corrections stay on Militia; Characters & officers shows them read-only. Activity must consume shared rule helpers rather than duplicate kind checks. The action schema inspected today has no Recruit Team manager argument; a later consumer update is not authorization to invent one.

Activity presentation and empty-slot removal do not change Weekly Resolution semantics, so they do not bump Ruleset Version. Use the version current after Upkeep; preserve the shipped settlement fix and all old record versions. Any additional schema/argument/result or resolution-rule change requires explicit approval before joining this scope.

## 6. Validation and coverage

Use react-hook-form + zod with `noValidate`, in-field styled errors and required/empty versus malformed-number distinctions. Preserve supported decimals (such as weight), signed custom modifiers, zero and blank-clear semantics. Existing cost units may remain; any gp display conversion must preserve exact integer copper and never truncate legacy amounts. Do not impose browser-native validation or turn advisory team/rule mismatches into disabled options. Server membership/campaign-reference checks remain mandatory.

Retain every existing E2E scenario with equivalent behavioral coverage. Rewrite obsolete drag/deck selectors to approved card/menu/clear interactions, not skipped tests:

| Existing coverage | Required equivalent |
| --- | --- |
| `e2e/realtime-action-slot.spec.ts` | One member places/edits a choice and the other sees it; reload preserves shared state. |
| `e2e/canonical-workspace.spec.ts`, `support/activity-workspace.ts` | Place, replace, move, swap, clear, team/cost/subject/roll, Rules Exceptions, over-allowance warning, independent phase views and rejected-save recovery. |
| Other workspace phase helpers | Nested Event/Persistent/Summary controls and candidate references remain usable as Activity editors change. |
| `e2e/complete-week.spec.ts`, `canonical-cutover.spec.ts`, `existing-militia.spec.ts` | Complete/confirm/reload into next week and immutable history; current/corrected campaigns and retained source facts remain valid. |
| `e2e/access.spec.ts`, nightly access flow, `character-ledger.spec.ts` | Membership/campaign isolation and later correction/officer edits continue to update Activity facts. |
| `e2e/canonical-persistence.spec.ts`, `canonical-confirmation.spec.ts` | Keep backend real-auth persistence, stale review, concurrent writers, retries/unknown acknowledgement, rollback and exact-revision Confirmation coverage, despite no browser-inventory mapping. |

Add meaningful tests at existing pure/controller/component and Convex integration seams for: all action variants/fields and legacy values; picker groups and empty/no-team states; move/swap preserving nested data and exceptions; positional Strategist/allowance changes; Helpful relocation, signed modifier reason/remove, failure and simultaneous-device cases; dual roll forms, partial/mismatched rolls, natural results and out-of-range warnings; receipt record/clear; references produced by earlier actions; missing references and explicit failed repair while another orphan exists.

ACT-19 must have server tests for empty-excess success, occupied rejection, in-allowance rejection, missing ID, changed allowance after the request's base, simultaneous fill/remove, repeated operation, duplicate removal, and closed/other-campaign/non-member rejection. Prove client optimistic removal/rejection recovery, stable subsequent slot IDs and unchanged Confirmation results for an otherwise equivalent draft. Integrate old/new operation parsing/replay tests rather than testing only a disabled button.

Use actual touch-capable browser coverage for scroll begun on action cards, sheet scrolling/selection, dismiss/cancel and no accidental placement while panning. Keyboard-only coverage must reach slots/cards, Change action, Move to, clear/remove, select/modifier forms and sheet close; focus returns to the originating slot (or nearest surviving slot after removal). Use named buttons, non-color warning text, persistent live status regions and correct sheet focus trapping. A removed/replaced remote choice closes or reconciles the local detail/picker target and cannot redirect its pending edit to another identity.

Verify at phone 390×844 plus landscape, tablet landscape about 1180×820 and desktop at least 1440×900. Add real two-member tests for detail edits, modifier/slot failures, allowance changes via corrections, reload and a Confirmation arriving while a picker is open. Run `pnpm -s typecheck`, `pnpm -s lint` and relevant unit/integration/E2E suites; report actual commands/results. Do not claim browser coverage from a component test.

## 7. Routes and rollout

Render at `/campaigns/<id>/week?phase=activity`. Shell owns the redirect from `/canonical-workspace?campaign=<id>&phase=activity`; preserve campaign/phase on direct entry, reload, Back/Forward and links from Characters & officers. Phase selection, selected slot, picker and detail expansion are local UI; underlying draft data is shared. No new persistent slot-selection field or public route is required.

Shipping dependencies are Navigation shell → Week frame → Upkeep → **Activity** → Event; later Persistent, Review & confirm, Setup, Militia corrections, Characters & officers, Finished weeks and campaign home follow the agreed chain. The authoring task graph is separate. Keep hosted old Event/Persistent/Summary editors functional and compatible throughout. Remove old Activity deck/drag components only when every operation and action-specific field has a reachable replacement. Keep existing correction/officer editors reachable until their successors replace them; do not block this delivery on those later layouts.

Phone: two-column slot grid, two action cards per picker row (three at tablet portrait), Operating from under the allowance, and stacked details. Fit all controls without horizontal page scrolling or clipping long labels. Extra slots stay reachable inside the board without creating page overflow. Tablet: selected board/detail main column inside the settled frame. Desktop ≥1280: use the frame's left phase rail, scrolling middle Activity body and right reference panel, with footer beneath the middle; do not add another page scrollbar. Details and picker must remain clear of phone status strip/bottom tabs, virtual keyboard and safe-area inset.

While loading use Activity-shaped placeholders within the frame; failure/retry/access/no-militia/maintenance follow the existing owners. A fresh week with empty slots shows selectable empty cards, not an error or artificial required action. No selected card shows a short instruction to choose a slot. No teams or settlements gives a truthful empty selection state and reachable Militia management without hiding teamless actions or existing staged choices.

### Published implementation handoffs

Implement after [Implement rules-ordered Upkeep and compatible shared dice totals](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/140). The next shipping area is [Implement rules-ordered Event preparation and occurrence resolution](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/143). The native dependencies between implementation issues encode this shipping order; authoring tasks are already complete.

## 8. Shippable when

- All ACT-01–18 operations and action fields are accounted for; only approved gestures/chrome are replaced. ACT-19 is implemented and server-validated without widening unrelated contracts.
- The approved tablet/phone/desktop layouts, accessible touch/keyboard interactions and empty/loading/failure/access states work with real shared data, no hidden required field and no clipped controls.
- All players can edit any slot; failures, remote changes and Confirmation correctly reconcile local sheets/details and never retarget stale edits. Existing and new roll forms, immutable records and other phase editors remain readable.
- Helpful/modifiers, allowances/Strategist, staged entities, receipts, Rules Exceptions and correction/reference handoffs retain their rule behavior and recovery limits. Later character rules are not prematurely applied.
- Update `docs/ui-capability-inventory.md` with actual locations and equivalent/new coverage while retaining IDs and explicit removal approvals. Required checks and relevant tests pass, including backend persistence/Confirmation and actual browser evidence. No prototype branch merge, unapproved payload change, or lost capability.
