body:
Implementation parent: [Militia UI rework](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/148) · Original planning map: [UI rework decisions](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/99) · Authoring task: [Write this area spec](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/128).

When creating implementation tickets from this spec, follow the [source traceability requirements](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/148#source-traceability-and-future-tickets): link back to this spec and carry forward the relevant decision-comment permalinks, amendments, pinned prototypes and capability IDs from the sections below.

## 1. Scope and ownership

Deliver **Persistent**, rollout position **6 of 12**, inside the shared Week frame. Players resolve carried persistent events in rules order, see the buyoff cadence and each event's projected result, enter checks or a reasoned table ending, and understand when Activity or Event has already ended an event. This is an implementation issue produced by [Write the Persistent implementation spec](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/128), outside the authoring map; it does not authorize merging a prototype.

[Week frame](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/137) owns Phase View navigation, fixed Persistent Phase Eligibility, all-phase Phase Readiness, This phase, reference values, shared save/recovery feedback and the next-week transition. This issue supplies Persistent's facts and editor. [Upkeep](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/140) owns the shared dice-total contract and compatibility; consume it without introducing another format. [Activity](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/142) owns Reduce Danger and its Action Slot. [Event](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/143) owns same-week occurrences, their nested persistent inputs and High Morale. Persistent and Event share the one-event-per-week Overseer allocation.

[Review & confirm authoring](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/129) owns the subsequent Summary, Table Adjustments and Confirmation redesign. Continue to support the current Summary and Confirmation until that issue ships. [Militia corrections](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/139) owns source correction/reference-repair recovery; [Characters & officers](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/141) owns the later kind/role/Hit Dice migration and must update this consumer. Their current editors remain reachable throughout. No new schema, query/mutation argument, result shape or Weekly Resolution rule change is approved in this issue.

### Main-column behavior

1. Lead with one wrapping buyoff overview: first buyoff availability, current projected cost, four-week cadence, and **Next buyoff week N** including accepted staged buyoffs. Derive these from the same Resolution Preview as Confirmation, including rank changes and earlier expenditure. Show an honest pending value when earlier preparation prevents calculation; never substitute a mock cost or assume the starting treasury/rank is the final value.
2. Render one numbered section per **week-start carried event**, ordered by `startedWeek`, then stored `order`, then stable `eventId` as the existing tie-breaker. Show name, started week, weeks elapsed, recorded within-week order and named targets (Militia if untargeted). Retain distinct instances with the same type/name. Do not let decision array order, a sort by label or remote edits reorder the sections.
3. Each section header has a concise projected result: e.g. **Ends · buyoff 160 gp**, **Stays · keeps 90% of this week's gains**, **Stays · officer check pending**, or **Buyoff needs a Rules Exception**. The section number becomes a check only when the preview actually stages an ending. These are forecasts until Confirmation; a selected card or entered reason alone is not proof an event ends.
4. Offer playing-card choices **Leave it**, **Loyalty check (this week only)** for Theft / **Officer check to end it** for Rivalry, **Buy off · <cost>**, and **Ended at the table**. Types without a supported check, including Low Morale and Double Agent, have no invented check card. Cards have concise rules notes and a visible selected state, support tap and keyboard, and allow scrolling that starts over them. No drag is necessary for this approved choice-card layout.
5. Put the selected decision's fields below its cards, followed by its results, warnings and Rules Exceptions. Keep relevant field-level errors within their field containers. Put missing-decision summaries and **Earlier phases still need preparation** in the frame's This phase/stepper/footer surfaces as well; no separate competing readiness system.
6. An event already ended by a resolved Activity/Event consequence remains in its original section and shows the source and a working change link, e.g. **Ends this week · staged by Reduce Danger in Activity slot 2. Change it in Activity.** It offers no redundant Persistent decision. Use actual source identity and outcome, not the mere presence of a Reduce Danger card or a High Morale roll. An incomplete, unsuccessful, negated or unselected source cannot hide an outstanding decision. A Table Adjustment applied after the Rules Baseline is not an earlier Activity/Event ending.

## 2. Decision sources

Read the linked discussions and amendments; these acceptance criteria apply the final approvals rather than treating mock data as a rulebook.

- [Persistent rules-order resolution](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/109#issuecomment-5837423122): variant A, carried-event sections, four decisions, checks, source endings and one-event Overseer support.
- [Persistent second-review amendment](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/109#issuecomment-5837634317): explicit removal of PER-09 Clear decision and PER-05 recorded buyoff cost plus its differing-amount warning; new buyoff writes omit `costCopper`.
- [Persistent final approval and copy](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/109#issuecomment-5837957108): source names in modifier breakdowns, **Use Overseer support · +N · one event a week** without a person or ability, **Next buyoff week N**, and **Buyoff cost N gp (2 × minimum treasury) · taken from the treasury at Confirmation**. This supersedes the earlier named-holder/Constitution prototype copy, including that copy quoted in Event's original cross-link/spec. Share the final copy with Event's toggle.
- [Shared Event/Persistent Overseer support](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/108#issuecomment-5837427038) and [Event implementation contract](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/143): shared allocation, legacy nested values and recoverable moves through existing edits.
- [Shared week layout](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/101#issuecomment-5831260876), [responsive shell and phase layouts](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/120#issuecomment-5846493929), and [shared loading/access/maintenance states](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/119#issuecomment-5846266381).
- [Roll format approval](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/107#issuecomment-5836751035) as concretized by [Upkeep's compatibility contract](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/140).
- [Twelve-spec rollout, ownership and completion gate](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/122#issuecomment-5846600504), map Notes in [Rework the militia UI for ease of use](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/99), `AGENTS.md`, `CONTEXT.md`, and `docs/ui-capability-inventory.md`.
- Rules authority: `docs/ai/ironfang-militia/militia-rules.md` (Persistent Events Rules, Theft, Rivalry, Low Morale, Double Agent, Overseer, Reduce Danger and High Morale), with hard numbers from `militia-tables.md`; exact wording is available in `militia-verbatim.md`.

## 3. Prototypes

| Pinned prototype | Approved variant and route | Full commit |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Persistent](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/tree/f6d5426439cfa16d3ff189a476005eff3d3664fe), branch `prototype/persistent` | A, rules order; `/prototype/persistent?variant=A` | `f6d5426439cfa16d3ff189a476005eff3d3664fe` |
| [Week layout](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/tree/14659d7dc6dc9062098055e29508fa3327912402), branch `prototype/week-layout` | A; `/prototype/week-layout?variant=A` | `14659d7dc6dc9062098055e29508fa3327912402` |
| [Responsive shell](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/tree/de10f4208904ca583d0fbc143bfc6314f0b9c0e7), branch `prototype/responsive-shell` | B; `/prototype/responsive-shell?variant=B`; direct `/prototype/responsive-shell/screen?variant=B&phase=persistent` | `de10f4208904ca583d0fbc143bfc6314f0b9c0e7` |

Prototype branches remain unmerged. Use `pnpm prototype` in their own worktrees for visual reference; do not copy mock reducers, fake save states, static costs/officers or mock event lists into the application. Final amendments govern over an older mock: no Clear decision, no recorded amount or differing-amount warning, final source-only modifier/toggle copy, and all existing non-mock inputs and outcomes remain covered. The real frame supplies access, feedback and responsive chrome.

Current main was checked against remote `eef41f7bad19e63ecce858e7a4490c937a4ece89`. At that snapshot the current Persistent editor still contains both removed controls, structured mitigation fields, plain copper output and the always-visible ending outcome. Upkeep's total contract and the other redesigns are planned prerequisites, not already-shipped behavior.

## 4. Capability accounting

All entries below are **planned** until implementation. Keep each stable inventory ID, including removed rows and their explicit approval; do not change current-location/coverage columns to claim this implementation already exists.

| ID | Acceptance and coverage obligation |
| --- | --- |
| PER-01 | Wrapping buyoff overview and oldest-first ordering; first buyoff, projected rules cost, next buyoff week, four-week wait and multiple staged buyoffs. Retain `ws:persistent` assertions and add rank-change, affordability and earlier-phase pending cases. |
| PER-02 | Per-event identity, start/age/order/targets and staged ending in the numbered header; keep ended instances visible. Add precise Activity/Event source links and undo-source behavior. |
| PER-03 | Tap/keyboard cards preserve leave, Theft's temporary mitigation, Rivalry's officer ending and buyoff. Leave it replaces the current decision with `unattempted`. Check success/failure, selected state, remote edit and reload. |
| PER-04 | Dedicated Theft roll/Overseer and Rivalry officer/skill/skill bonus/roll fields with complete modifier editing and retained schema-supported fields. Preserve nested field save/clear/list operations where applicable; test old and new rolls plus shared support moves. |
| PER-05 | **Signed-off removal:** recorded buyoff amount and its differing-amount warning. Display the rules cost; new `buyoff` writes omit `costCopper`. Keep old stored values/history compatible. Approval: [second-review amendment](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/109#issuecomment-5837634317). |
| PER-06 | Ended at the table card, **How it ended**, stable acknowledgement identity/subject and required reasoned Rules Exception. No ending from an empty outcome/reason or narrative text alone. |
| PER-07 | Raw dice total + applicable bonus = total vs DC, modifier sources and projected buyoff/officer/temporary-mitigation outcomes. No duplicate bonuses, false completed result or loss of the staged financial/effect consequences. |
| PER-08 | Event-local warning context and reason entry/edit/removal for every existing Rules Exception; counts/details in This phase remain consistent. Replacing the decision does not erase unrelated exceptions. |
| PER-09 | **Signed-off removal:** standalone Clear decision button. Leave it provides the explicit reset path. Keep the existing clear edit/parser for compatibility and other valid consumers. Same [second-review amendment](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/109#issuecomment-5837634317). |
| PER-10 | Per-event requirements plus earlier-phase readiness in This phase, stepper and footer; incomplete optional attempts differ from unattempted. All ended sections remain reviewable and Persistent Phase Eligibility stays fixed. |

| Shared IDs | Owner and Persistent obligation |
| --- | --- |
| WEEK-01, WEEK-02, WEEK-03 | Week frame owns accessible week/phase heading, five steps, fixed eligibility and independent Phase View. Persistent supplies facts and honors links without changing other players' phase. |
| WEEK-04, WEEK-05, WEEK-06, WEEK-07, WEEK-08 | Frame owns shared optimistic edits, save/remote/rejection feedback, latest-saved rollback, fresh-review requirement and pending-departure warning. Every Persistent field/card/exception/support move uses that same store and gateway. |
| WEEK-09, WEEK-10, WEEK-11, WEEK-12 | Frame owns Setup notes, Confirmation lock, successor transition and week loading/failure/empty states. Keep notes reachable, disable every Persistent write while confirming, and never send a delayed old-week operation to the successor. |
| WEEK-13 | This issue owns Persistent's accessible tap/keyboard cards. Retain shared card semantics, focus/selected feedback and scrolling; this approval does not remove drag globally in other editors. |
| WEEK-14, WEEK-15, WEEK-16 | Upkeep owns whole-number/total compatibility. Persistent consumes digits/invalid/zero/clear handling and advisory range warnings, including officer/nested rolls; do not restore multi-die ordered-entry controls. |
| WEEK-17 | Shell/frame own responsive chrome; Persistent owns fitting sections/cards/fields/errors at each agreed viewport. |
| WEEK-18 | Persistent owns full fidelity of its nested decision fields, targets, rolls and custom modifiers. Event owns same-week nested persistent decisions. Preserve list add/edit/remove and field save/clear operations rather than dropping fields absent from mocks. |
| ACT-10, ACT-13, ACT-17 | Activity owns action-specific details, calculated checks and its warnings/exceptions; Persistent consumes resolved Reduce Danger endings and links to their source. Do not duplicate or edit the Action Slot here. |
| EVT-07, EVT-10, EVT-11, EVT-12, EVT-14 | Event owns occurrence inputs/checks/warnings/outcomes/readiness, same-week nested persistent decisions and High Morale. Share Overseer state and ending facts with Persistent without duplicating decisions. |
| SUM-01, SUM-02, SUM-03, SUM-04, SUM-05, SUM-06, SUM-07, SUM-08, SUM-09, SUM-10, SUM-11 | Review & confirm owns readiness/review/single-winner Confirmation/stale recovery, Rules Baseline and Final, Rules Exceptions, Table Adjustments, warnings, consequences and recorded outcomes. Preserve current Summary behavior and supply Persistent facts, including consistent removed-warning presentation; no Summary capability is removed by this issue. |
| NAV-15 | Shell owns scoped route parsing/redirects; frame owns phase normalization/local navigation. This issue consumes `phase=persistent` and source phase links. |
| STATE-01, STATE-02, STATE-03, STATE-05, STATE-06, STATE-07 | Shell owns access/maintenance/shared failure; frame owns week states. Persistent supplies its layout skeleton and reload/multi-device regression coverage, with no stale protected-data flash. |

No additional capability IDs are needed. Source-ending links and shared support are concrete coverage within PER-02/04/07, not an excuse to drop existing targets, fields or results. Only PER-05 and PER-09 are removed by this area's decision; no exception, officer check, modifier, persistent event type or historical fact is signed off for removal.

## 5. Data, payloads and rules

### Preserve existing operations and source ownership

Use `weekly-draft-facts.ts`, `weekly-draft-contract.ts`, `weekly-draft.ts`, `rules-persistent-events.ts`, `rules-event-checks.ts`, `rules-overseer-event.ts`, `rules-officers.ts` and workspace `persistent-{facts,view,outcomes}` as live seams. Keep the route presentational, orchestration in focused hooks, writes behind the existing gateway, and display/readiness derivations in pure shared helpers. Do not use effects to maintain duplicate derived outcomes.

- Carried rows come from `draft.context.carriedEvents`. Preserve event identity/type, start/order, targets, source IDs and recorded mitigation facts. Corrections do not make these editable carried-state fields; the Militia page displays carried state read-only.
- Use existing `persistent_decision`, `clear_persistent_decision`, `rules_exception`, `clear_rules_exception` and the already-supported event edits as appropriate. Keep stable event, acknowledgement, modifier and exception identities; they are not list indices. Existing `persistent_decision` routing stores a current occurrence's decision on that occurrence and carried decisions in the Persistent collection; preserve this behavior and replay/conflict targets.
- Same-week events stay under their owning Event occurrence (including Activity-origin candidate occurrences). Retain their existing `persistent`, `persistentDecision`, targets/checks and required exceptions there. They do not add a carried row or unlock an ineligible Persistent step this week. Their surviving carried state is available in next week's context after Confirmation. Do not drop same-week inputs merely because the Persistent page is locked, migrate them to `persistent.decisions`, or manufacture a second decision for their ID.
- A missing decision and explicit `unattempted` keep their existing unattempted semantics. **Leave it** writes `{ kind: 'unattempted', eventId }` and stops using the prior decision's rolls/ending/buyoff; it must not reset another event, the entire week or unrelated Rules Exceptions.
- Preserve all valid mitigation fields: `officerCheck` (character, skill, skill bonus, roll), `overseerCharacterId`, `rolls`, `targets` and `strategistCharacterId`. The main Theft/Rivalry editor exposes relevant fields plainly; retained details keep existing supported values visible and intentionally editable/clearable without falsely claiming irrelevant fields affect the check. Target variants remain event/item/team/settlement/character/cache with stable scoped IDs. Updating one visible input must not reconstruct a decision from only the prototype's fields. Ordinary edit preserves sibling values; explicitly changing decision kind is a deliberate replacement.
- Source labels and target options use the existing source/preview facts, including entities produced earlier in the draft. Preserve distinguishable unavailable-target states. Follow corrections' complete-reference restoration/repair procedure if the whole-draft validator rejects orphaned IDs; do not promise unrelated edits or one orphan's clear can save around another unresolved orphan.

### Checks and adjudication

Theft's DC 20 Loyalty check gives mitigation for this week only: a successful check retains 90% of applicable incoming gains, and the event remains. A failed or unattempted check retains the normal loss; next week needs its own mitigation. Use the existing whole-week projection so temporary mitigation updates dependent treasury calculations in the proper order, including buyoff affordability; do not locally patch just a header percentage.

Rivalry exposes character selection with role context, Diplomacy/Bluff/Intimidate, signed whole-number skill bonus, and one d20 total. A zero skill bonus is valid; empty bonus is incomplete. Preserve the existing non-officer exception path, unavailable character validation and DC 20 success/failure. This is the chosen character's skill check, not an organization check: do not add militia officer/Overseer bonuses to it. Two distinct stored team targets and their restrictions stay visible and rules-validated. Ending it does not retroactively erase an earlier restriction contrary to existing weekly ordering.

Theft shows the calculated organization bonus and named contributions such as **Officers +2 · Overseer +3**, plus entered modifiers with reasons. Keep the applied non-stacking officer, queued, Helpful, one-use and custom-source rules; no double-counting a source that is already calculated. Rivalry's breakdown uses its skill and applicable custom modifiers. Provide custom modifier add/edit/remove with stable source identity, signed amount and reason; no new numeric Table Adjustment control here.

**Ended at the table** reveals **How it ended** and the required `persistent-ending` Rules Exception reason. Preserve acknowledgement identity on edits and set `subjectId` to that exact event. The existing strict acknowledgement requires nonempty outcome text: opening an empty card form is local editing intent, not a valid saved `end` payload. Retain the last accepted decision until valid input can be sent, communicate unsaved/invalid form state, and do not invent an empty acknowledgement or change the schema. Write the valid ending and exception through existing operations; pending/partial failure is visible and repairable, and Confirmation cannot use an incomplete or unreconciled result. Clearing the exception revokes its permission and restores the requirement; Leave it resets the decision. The narrative outcome and exception reason remain distinct facts. A Rules Exception permits the choice; changing numeric results remains a Table Adjustment in Review & confirm.

### Buyoff and removed amount compatibility

The buyoff card writes `{ kind: 'buyoff', eventId }`. Display **Buyoff cost N gp (2 × minimum treasury) · taken from the treasury at Confirmation**. Currency is presentation over integer copper; display existing precision accurately and never write a rounded amount. The resolver still computes cost from the current rules/rank, handles the first buyoff immediately, enforces the four-week wait for later ones, resolves events oldest first, and requires existing `buyoff-cooldown`/`treasury` exceptions where applicable. Do not disable valid table exceptions merely because funds or cadence differ from rules; do not mark an unmet exception as an ending.

Keep legacy `costCopper` parse/read support. Opening a draft, navigating or reading a record never strips or rewrites it. A deliberate new buyoff selection writes the approved amount-free form; other event edits preserve their stored data. The old differing-recorded-amount warning is removed from the live presentation and its live counts consistently, including This phase/current Summary. This is presentation filtering only: do not alter the immutable source or warnings/results of older Resolution Records, delete the legacy parser/clear operation, or change the resolver solely to erase historical evidence. History remains readable from its selected record. Legacy costs never become actual deductions or a substitute for Table Adjustments.

### Overseer allocation and changes elsewhere

Show a filled-role toggle on applicable organization checks: **Use Overseer support · +N · one event a week**. Show a muted truthful unavailable state if unassigned. The contribution comes from the existing applicable officer calculation, including the appropriate ability choice and non-stacking behavior; it is not a hardcoded Constitution value or a freely chosen character. Honor a valid saved holder and the later Characters & officers contract; if multiple holders are present, use the deterministic applicable contributor from shared officer derivation rather than creating a new person-picker/rule. Stale/archived/missing selections remain diagnosable and repairable; do not silently erase them or fabricate a filled role.

Display where the shared support is currently allocated, e.g. **Now on Theft (week 9). Tapping moves it here.** Use the existing event identity to unify occurrence-level, target-check, Sabotage and nested persistent-decision selections; repeated checks of one occurrence share one support use, distinct carried instances do not. Moving between Persistent events or Event and Persistent clears conflicting selections in their owning records and sets the destination through the existing semantic edits. Preserve every unrelated input on each affected record.

Inherit Event's ordered mutation path: await/reconcile each accepted edit, then derive the next edit from the latest accepted/optimistic state. Do not fire concurrent whole-record replacements from one stale snapshot or present the multi-edit move as atomic. If a clear succeeds but assignment fails, show the accepted unassigned state and retry/repair path; if any step fails, stop and reconcile before continuing. Do not silently retry stale intent over a remote change. Concurrent moves from two members must either reach one valid shared allocation or expose the existing conflict/readiness requirement with a reachable repair; they may never silently grant the bonus twice. Keep normal frame saving/error/remote-change feedback and stale-review invalidation throughout.

Derive Activity/Event endings from preview provenance and source IDs. Existing redundant Persistent decisions remain stored when an upstream ending wins; do not delete them during render. If that source is undone, the saved decision becomes visible again with recalculated requirements/results. The end source link navigates locally to the matching slot/occurrence where possible; the original phase's repair controls remain responsible. This preserves fixed eligibility even when every carried event ends.

### Ruleset and storage boundary

[Fix persistent Rivalry lifecycle across weeks](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/31) is a separate open request whose repro names retired `week-board-mutation-harness`/`militiaEventState` paths. Current canonical code already carries instance targets and resolves officer ending checks; `rules-persistent-events.test.ts` includes `[rules.P02.rivalry.*]` for weeks 2–4, absent/failed checks, successful ending and subsequent team availability. Preserve and rerun that canonical coverage here. Do not import the old `mitigationUntilWeek` model, introduce a dependency on the legacy fix, claim it was closed, or silently add its proposed schema work to this UI issue. If that request is reconciled or canonical behavior changes independently before implementation, integrate against the accepted canonical contract and its tests.

This issue changes presentation and uses already-approved contracts; it does **not** need a new Ruleset Version. Consume the version current when it ships. Upkeep/Event/Characters & officers own their separately approved behavior changes and allocate the next unused version when needed. Preserve existing Resolution Record versions, sources, warnings, plans and outcomes; never re-resolve old history using today's officers or rules. If implementation reveals a need for another schema/argument/result or resolution-behavior change, obtain explicit human approval before expanding this scope. No new allocation endpoint, persistent-phase eligibility write, acknowledgement relaxation, eager backfill or record rewrite is approved.

## 6. Validation and coverage

Use `react-hook-form` with `zod`, styled field-level errors and `noValidate`. Distinguish required/empty from malformed input; block structural invalidity, invalid enum/identity/type, unsafe numbers and foreign references. Required-for-resolution inputs may remain absent in a shared draft where existing schemas allow it. Dice totals follow Upkeep's strict alternatives: legacy `{ dice, sides, provenance, modifiers }` or new `{ diceTotal, diceCount, sides, provenance, modifiers }`, never both; preserve provenance/modifiers. New edits use totals, 1d20 has count 1/sides 20, a complete legacy array reads equivalently without rewrite, partial/wrong-count/sides stays incomplete. Zero/out-of-range nonnegative whole totals persist with advisory warnings; blank clears and malformed/negative dice input does not masquerade as zero. Signed skill bonuses/modifiers remain valid. Do not count entered modifiers inside the dice total.

Retain every existing E2E scenario with equivalent behavioral assertions. Explicit changes to existing scenarios:

| Existing coverage | Required treatment |
| --- | --- |
| `e2e/support/persistent-workspace.ts` | Keep oldest-first identity/targets, immediate first buyoff, shared cooldown exception, both buyoffs, ending+reason, Theft mitigation, zero/invalid/blank roll, Rivalry, observer reload, delayed rejected mutation, independent phase navigation and all responsive bounds. Replace Clear decision with Leave it; copper result locators with exact gp-equivalent consequences; generic roll builder locators with dedicated fields. |
| `e2e/support/persistent-qa.ts` | Retain independent review, only-applicable check controls, no irrelevant newly offered rolls, dice specification, readable results and tablet/phone/desktop control geometry. Retained legacy-field details must not be confused with new inapplicable choices. |
| `e2e/canonical-workspace.spec.ts` and Event/Activity/Summary support helpers | Preserve full shared workspace journey, cross-phase source endings, nested same-week decisions and shared support; readiness and warnings must match all presentation surfaces. |
| `e2e/complete-week.spec.ts`, `e2e/canonical-confirmation.spec.ts` | Keep exact reviewed source/revision, stale review, atomic Confirmation, ending/buyoff outcomes, immutable record and successor identity/eligibility. |
| `e2e/canonical-persistence.spec.ts` | Keep direct backend operation/replay/auth/isolation/rollback/dropped-acknowledgement scenarios even though the capability inventory does not map them to browser rows. |
| `e2e/existing-militia.spec.ts`, `access.spec.ts`, `canonical-cutover.spec.ts`, relevant character/realtime suites | Preserve setup/correction reference repair, membership/organization isolation, reload and maintenance behavior; do not weaken unrelated coverage because locators moved. |

Add or extend focused tests in `rules-persistent-events.test.ts`, relevant event/officer tests, `weekly-draft.test.ts`, persistence/confirmation suites, workspace phase/persistent component tests and canonical preview/storage integration suites:

1. Stable oldest-first/tied ordering, duplicate event types with distinct IDs, ages/targets, first buyoff and exact four-week boundary, consecutive attempted buyoffs, insufficient funds, each exception independently record/edit/remove, and changing rank/earlier treasury changes recomputing the rules cost. Entered legacy `costCopper` never controls deductions and its removed warning is absent consistently from the live UI.
2. Theft unattempted/success/failure, same-week-only 90% retention, repeated next-week need and whole-week income/affordability effect. Rivalry all three skills, zero/negative/empty bonus, success/failure, non-officer exception, unavailable officer and distinct targets. Low Morale/Double Agent have no invented mitigation UI; unsupported legacy attempts stay repairable.
3. Ending outcome nonempty/blank/invalid, stable subject/acknowledgement identity, reason record/edit/remove, partial save/rejection and Leave it reset. No empty strict payload is sent; no stale hidden saved decision is confirmed unintentionally while a local form remains unfinished.
4. Every supported nested field/modifier survives unrelated edits, reload and mixed legacy/total drafts; field clear/list edits remain possible. Source-only bonus labels, counted-once contributions, malformed numeric versus blank/range behavior, old complete/partial arrays and new totals produce correct checks and client/server-equivalent previews.
5. Fixed eligibility: carried events all ended still leave a reachable Persistent step; no carried events keep it locked despite a new same-week persistent event; Event retains that event's nested inputs/decisions/exceptions; next week's eligibility derives from surviving carried state. Source endings hide redundant choices only after an actual result, link to the exact source and reveal retained decisions if undone.
6. Overseer unassigned/assigned/archived, actual ability contribution, legacy nested selection, multiple checks on one occurrence, distinct events, toggling off and moving both directions between Event and Persistent. Test failed first clear, successful clear/failed set, dropped acknowledgement, remote change mid-move and competing two-member moves; check no duplicate bonus, no lost unrelated fields, truthful current allocation and reachable conflict recovery.
7. Two members editing the same decision/roll/exception get accepted-state conflict semantics, optimistic feedback, rollback and fresh-review requirements; Phase View/focus remain local. Reload persists accepted results. Confirmation disables every editing affordance; old draft edits cannot reach the successor, and all devices adopt its Upkeep through the frame.
8. Non-member/foreign-organization reads and writes fail; spoofed campaign/draft/event/officer/team/target IDs fail at the server. All members share permission, with no GM-only controls. Maintenance keeps content readable and rejected writes use normal recoverable feedback. Missing whole-draft references follow the existing correction/restoration contract.
9. Read old Resolution Records containing recorded buyoff amounts, arrays, acknowledgement/reason facts and versions unchanged; new records use the accepted new draft facts. No read creates a mutation or recalculates old results. Preserve Confirmation/persistence assertions outside the browser inventory.

At phone 390×844 and landscape, tablet 1180×820 with panel open/closed, and desktop 1440×900, verify no horizontal document scroll, cut-off card labels, overlapping error rows, hidden controls under the fixed bars or unusable mobile keyboard states. Check keyboard selection/focus, accessible group/field names identifying the event, selected-state semantics, live error/save announcements and reduced-motion behavior. Validate real preview values, not screenshots alone.

Run `pnpm -s typecheck`, `pnpm -s lint`, relevant unit/integration tests and affected E2E journeys using the repository's isolated-preview harness. Record actual results and any environment limitation; unrun live checks are not passed checks. Writing this specification itself does not run a deployment or constitute feature validation.

## 7. Routes and rollout

The live destination is `/campaigns/<id>/week?phase=persistent`. Consume shell redirects from `/canonical-workspace?campaign=<id>&phase=persistent`, preserved campaign context and frame Back/Forward/local-phase behavior. An ineligible direct Persistent link normalizes to Upkeep under the frame contract; an eligible phase remains accessible after its carried events all end. Source links go to `phase=activity` or `phase=event` and retain the correct campaign and subject. Do not add a second Persistent route, editor or Confirmation button.

Native implementation dependency: **this issue is blocked by [Event](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/143)**. The [Review & confirm output](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/129) must be natively blocked by this implementation issue when published. Shipping order remains shell → frame → Upkeep → Activity → Event → Persistent → Review & confirm → Setup → Militia corrections → Characters & officers → Finished weeks → campaign home. Authoring dependencies do not replace these shipping edges.

Ship with the already-compatible totals/shared semantic edits from Upkeep and Event. Before removing the current Persistent editor, verify every PER row, supported nested operation, source-link repair, warning/exception and shared regression scenario has its replacement. Keep current Summary, Confirmation, history and roster/officer/correction access usable; remove their temporary routes/editors only under their owning specs. Source input controls for same-week persistent events remain in Event, including when the Persistent step is unavailable. Coordinate the final Overseer copy and removed-live-warning presentation across these existing consumers in this delivery, without waiting for their later redesigns.

### Published implementation handoffs

Implement after [Implement rules-ordered Event preparation and occurrence resolution](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/143). The next shipping area is [Implement Review & confirm with ordered consequences and exact reviewed Confirmation](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/145). The native dependencies between implementation issues encode this shipping order; authoring tasks are already complete.

## 8. Shippable when

- PER-01 through PER-10 and the enumerated shared IDs have the specified implemented or explicitly removed status, with no hidden unsupported field, orphaned reference, legacy amount or partial support move trapping the week.
- The buyoff overview, stable carried-event sections, cards, applicable checks/modifiers, outcomes, warning/reason editing and ended-elsewhere links reflect the real shared preview. Leave it resets; table endings require their actual outcome and reason; no cost entry or Clear decision button remains.
- Same-week Event inputs remain accessible in Event; fixed eligibility and next-week carry behavior match the rules. Overseer allocation is shared, non-duplicating and recoverable across phases, using final approved source-only copy.
- The strict roll compatibility, operation/identity/conflict behavior, membership/campaign isolation, immutable records and existing Confirmation contract are preserved. No unapproved backend contract or Ruleset Version change is included.
- Tablet landscape shows the one-line wrapping overview and numbered sections with cards in a row where space permits. Below 768px, cards form 2×2 where four exist, the three-choice no-check case wraps without a fake fourth option, result headers wrap, and field rows stack. At desktop 1280px and above, content scrolls in the frame's middle column with footer below it; the overall page does not scroll. The frame supplies phone sheets/status strip and docked tablet/desktop panel.
- Persistent's skeleton resembles its overview/sections; week failure offers **The week could not be loaded. / Try again** within the usable shell, no militia offers **Set up militia**, unavailable campaigns use the shell's neutral gate, and maintenance remains readable. Pending earlier phases and an eligible phase with every event ended have honest, usable states. Long names, warnings and fields fit the layout, use theme tokens/fonts/shadcn components, and remain keyboard/touch accessible.
- Inventory planned-to-shipped status, actual current locations and concrete coverage are updated without deleting signed-off removal history. Required typecheck/lint/tests pass with recorded E2E evidence and clearly identified environment limitations.

body:
Implementation parent: [Militia UI rework](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/148) · Original planning map: [UI rework decisions](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/99) · Authoring task: [Write this area spec](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/129).

When creating implementation tickets from this spec, follow the [source traceability requirements](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/148#source-traceability-and-future-tickets): link back to this spec and carry forward the relevant decision-comment permalinks, amendments, pinned prototypes and capability IDs from the sections below.

## 1. Scope and ownership

Deliver **Review & confirm, rollout position 7 of 12**, after [carried Persistent events](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/144). Replace Summary's main column with the approved review block and six numbered sections. Any organization member can review shared choices, edit Rules Exception reasons and ordered Table Adjustments, inspect the Rules Baseline and Final preview, and confirm exactly the saved week they reviewed.

This implementation issue is outside the [UI planning map](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/99), authored by [Write the Review & confirm implementation spec](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/129). Application main inspected: `eef41f7bad19e63ecce858e7a4490c937a4ece89`. The inventory authoring branch contains planned accounting only; the UI below is not shipped.

Own the review block, Required decisions and Go links, warnings, Confirmation and fresh-review controls, phase consequences, inline adjudication, ordered adjustment forms and Result presentation. Establish the reusable, pure six-section presentation boundary described in section 5. [Finished weeks authoring](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/133) owns its later historical adapter integration, week list, audit paging, dates and read-only navigation.

The [Week frame](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/137) owns navigation/readiness aggregation, This phase, reference values, save/error/remote-change feedback, pending departure protection, all-control disabling and the cross-device Confirmation-to-successor transition. Consume its single store/lifecycle; do not create another Confirmation button or readiness authority. [Navigation shell](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/135) owns campaign access, maintenance and shared failed-load presentation. Phase input editors remain with [Upkeep](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/140), [Activity](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/142), [Event](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/143) and [Persistent](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/144). [Militia corrections](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/139) owns source/reference repair; [Characters & officers](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/141) owns its later kind/manager/Hit Dice migration across consumers. Neither later layout is a prerequisite for this one.

### Main-column acceptance

- At the top retain **Review the week**, **Required decisions**, all **Warnings**, stale-review alert with **Review updated week**, and **Confirm week**. Required decisions identify the actual missing choice/reason, with **Go** to its phase and relevant item; Summary-owned forms receive local focus. Links use the frame's local navigation and never change another player's Phase View. Warnings remain advisory unless the existing resolver also supplies a requirement.
- Remove the review block's ready/needs-attention sentence and explanatory applies-the-entire-week note. Keep a disabled button reason next to Confirm and in the frame's corresponding footer/status presentation: e.g. **2 decisions left**, **Review will be ready when your changes are saved.**, or the actual stale-review/local-form reason. When confirmable, no readiness sentence is shown. The frame already removes the Summary step caption and ready/needs-attention footer; do not reintroduce either in phone sheets or desktop rail.
- Below, render exactly **1 Upkeep, 2 Activity, 3 Event, 4 Persistent, 5 Table Adjustments, 6 Result · week N+1 begins**. Sections 1–4 are expanded, in that order, even when one has no consequences; give an honest empty/not-applicable/incomplete line. Their header chips show net phase changes derived from existing plans; each consequence shows named subject, check detail and its effect, in actual rules order. Event includes reactive Sabotage under its occurrence, not a seventh phase. Same-week persistent decisions belong to their Event source; carried-event decisions belong to Persistent. Do not double-count one effect in both sections.
- Under each consequence, show its warning in amber, Rules Exception with rule chip and inline reason, and recorded outcome as a quoted line. Each fact remains separately identifiable, including identical messages attached to distinct subjects. An exception whose original item is gone remains visible in its phase. An obsolete action-allowance exception retains its explanation and **Remove obsolete exception**; a reason never makes an unavailable slot usable. Phase owners retain outcome-entry controls; Summary presents those outcomes and links back for repair.
- Section 5 says **applied after the Rules Baseline, in this order**. Each numbered adjustment shows effect chip, kind, inline reason, Edit and Remove. Earlier/later controls appear only with more than one adjustment, with inaccessible moves disabled at the ends. Four playing-card choices below the list—**Militia value**, **Team condition**, **Settlement reputation**, **End persistent event**—open a form with **Save** and **Cancel**. With none: **No Table Adjustments. The Final preview equals the Rules Baseline.**
- Section 6 has columns **Value / Now / Rules Baseline / Final**. Default to rows changed between Now and baseline or baseline and Final, including a change later reversed by an adjustment. Highlight Final only where it differs from baseline; also describe the difference in text. **Show all values** reveals every existing militia fact plus roster, officers and next-week context. It toggles local presentation only. No new collapsed phase sections or prototype-only value subset.

## 2. Decision sources

Read full discussions and later amendments; these links own the decisions, while this issue defines their acceptance and compatibility boundaries.

- [Summary variant B and signed-off review-copy removals](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/110#issuecomment-5844063536).
- [Shared Week frame](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/101#issuecomment-5831260876), with the later Summary copy amendment taking precedence.
- [Loading, unavailable, failure, maintenance and successor transition](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/119#issuecomment-5846266381).
- [Responsive shell and phase fixes, variant B](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/120#issuecomment-5846493929).
- [Finished weeks' six-section record presentation](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/117#issuecomment-5845007868) and its [authoritative payload/paging amendment](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/117#issuecomment-5845032926): history consumes frozen facts; listing query/dates belong to that owner, audit paging stays and correction notes are omitted.
- [Twelve-spec rollout, ownership and completion gate](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/122#issuecomment-5846600504).
- Adjacent implementation contracts linked in section 1, especially Upkeep's exact dual roll format and Persistent's live-only recorded-buyoff-warning removal. Underlying sign-off: [Persistent amount/control removal amendment](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/109#issuecomment-5837634317).

Use `CONTEXT.md` terminology. Numeric thresholds and Weekly Resolution remain defined by the existing canonical rules code and `docs/ai/ironfang-militia/militia-tables.md` / `militia-rules.md`; this presentation must not create a second rule engine.

## 3. Prototypes

| Reference | Approved variant and route | Pinned commit |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Summary](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/tree/65d472dcf4bb65094efb97b621c7bbae3ee18965), branch `prototype/summary` | B, rules-order story; `/prototype/summary?variant=B` | `65d472dcf4bb65094efb97b621c7bbae3ee18965`, includes approved review-copy changes |
| [Responsive shell](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/tree/de10f4208904ca583d0fbc143bfc6314f0b9c0e7), branch `prototype/responsive-shell` | B; `/prototype/responsive-shell?variant=B`; direct `/prototype/responsive-shell/screen?variant=B&phase=summary` | `de10f4208904ca583d0fbc143bfc6314f0b9c0e7` |

The four Summary alternatives as initially reviewed are pinned at `48114aff3864403c675df6ff6b65eb5094c9aff4`; A/C/D are not approved. Keep prototype branches unmerged. Do not ship state toggles, fixture data, mock reducers or hardcoded week/phase chips. Later approved copy/state changes override stale prototype chrome. Real implementation must cover complete nested facts, strict form behavior, incomplete previews, accepted-state concurrency, old/new rolls and historical compatibility beyond the mock. Use existing theme tokens, fonts and shadcn/ui; thin views delegate orchestration and mutations to focused hooks, with pure shared presentation derivations.

## 4. Capability accounting

Retain stable inventory IDs. The following locations and coverage are **planned**, not shipped; implementation updates actual locations/tests after delivery.

| ID | Required acceptance and coverage |
| --- | --- |
| SUM-01 | Required decisions and contextual disabled reason replace ready/needs-attention sentences; retain unsaved-changes reason. Test ready, incomplete, pending, invalid local form and stale review with no redundant ready sentence. |
| SUM-02 | Whole-week Required decisions, readable subjects and Go links, including missing reasons; test all four source phases and local adjustment repair. |
| SUM-03 | Confirm only the complete, saved, accepted and reviewed source, with no unfinished local form; pending label and exactly reviewed outcome. Preserve week/workspace and backend contract coverage. |
| SUM-04 | Preserve existing single-winner concurrent Confirmation, stale source/revision rejection and edit/confirm race. Shared persistence/store behavior is unchanged, even though the design prototype omitted it. |
| SUM-05 | Stale alert and explicit Review updated week, disabled during pending work; failed save/Confirmation cannot silently refresh authorization. Preserve workspace recovery tests. |
| SUM-06 | Result Now/Rules Baseline/Final, changed-only/show-all, all militia and next-week facts, named references, complete/incomplete state. Rewrite existing outcome-disclosure browser assertions without losing facts. |
| SUM-07 | Inline Rules Exceptions, edit reason, one-tap clear, orphaned-subject display and remove obsolete action allowance; identity and underlying rule semantics preserved. Add browser coverage. |
| SUM-08 | All four adjustment kinds and every existing field; add/edit/reason/remove/cancel/earlier/later, exact gp input, full ordered-list replacement and failure recovery. Preserve all `summary-qa` variants. |
| SUM-09 | Review-block Warnings plus item placement and phase fallback, correct identities/counts, readable labels and live-only approved warning filtering. Add browser coverage. |
| SUM-10 | Four expanded consequence sections, phase net chips, actual execution order, Event/Sabotage integration and all existing effects. Add focused and browser assertions. |
| SUM-11 | Every acknowledgement remains visible under its actual source, including orphan/unmapped fallback; preserve distinct quoted outcomes and stable identity. Add browser assertions. |

Shared IDs are individually accounted for:

| ID | Obligation here; primary owner |
| --- | --- |
| NAV-15 | Consume campaign/`phase=summary` deep link and redirects; shell owns routing, frame owns Phase View. |
| WEEK-01 | Keep accessible week/phase context; frame owns heading/chrome. |
| WEEK-02 | Supply Summary requirements/warnings, local Go navigation and no Summary caption; frame owns stepper/readiness. |
| WEEK-03 | Review, Show all and local forms/focus do not navigate other devices; frame owns independent Phase View. |
| WEEK-04 | Accepted exception/adjustment edits sync to every member; frame owns shared feedback/store. |
| WEEK-05 | Existing optimistic Resolution Preview drives consequences/comparison; frame/store owns forecast. |
| WEEK-06 | Use one saving/saved/failed/confirming status; frame owns status placement. |
| WEEK-07 | Failed edit restores latest accepted values and requires fresh review; frame/store owns recovery, this issue owns visible review control. |
| WEEK-08 | Preserve departure protection while writes/Confirmation are pending; frame/shell own guard. Local form state cannot masquerade as saved data. |
| WEEK-10 | Disable all adjustment/exception forms and destructive controls during Confirmation; frame owns global barrier. |
| WEEK-11 | Keep confirmed week displayed until successor arrives, then adopt successor Upkeep; frame owns transition. |
| WEEK-12 | Summary-shaped content skeleton within frame week states; shell owns campaign unavailable. |
| WEEK-13 | Four adjustment kind cards and choice controls support tap/keyboard/selected semantics; this area owns its approved replacement, no global drag deletion. |
| WEEK-14 | Required versus malformed numeric input, clear/zero and signed adjustment semantics retained; this area owns form validation, Upkeep owns shared roll input work. |
| WEEK-15 | Render Upkeep-owned new dice totals and legacy dice arrays correctly without rewriting them; no roll migration here. |
| WEEK-16 | Preserve advisory range warnings and honest check details; phase owners/Upkeep own inputs. |
| WEEK-17 | Own Summary cards/result/errors at tablet, phone and desktop; frame/shell own surrounding responsive layout. |
| WEEK-18 | Preserve full discriminated adjustment fields, selection, Save/Clear/remove/reorder operations; source phases own their nested editors. |
| WEEK-19 | Consume one Week N confirmed notice and its correct historical-week link on every observing device; frame owns it. |
| HIST-05 | Share the six-section presentation contract and record-only boundary; Finished weeks owns historical adapter/page and its compatibility tests. |
| STATE-01 | Readable maintenance banner and normal recoverable write failures; shell owns banner, frame feedback. |
| STATE-02 | Summary-shaped loading placeholders under frame/shell scaffold. |
| STATE-03 | Consume shared failed-load card and frame Try again. |
| STATE-05 | Keep week loading/failure/no militia distinct from unavailable campaign; frame/shell own gates. |
| STATE-06 | Exception/adjustment/Confirmation results survive reload and appear on another member's device; shared regression responsibility. |
| STATE-07 | Consume neutral membership/organization/sign-in gate; shell owns it. |

No new ID is required. **Signed-off replacements/removals**, all retained in inventory history:

- [Summary approval](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/110#issuecomment-5844063536): SUM-01 ready/needs-attention sentence and the review block's applies-the-entire-prepared-week explanatory note disappear. Remove the current equivalent wording as well as the prototype literal. Frame already owns the stepper caption/footer removal; disabled reasons remain.
- Same approval: SUM-06's side-by-side outcome cards and individual disclosures become one changed-only Result with Show all; SUM-07's detached exception list becomes item-inline; SUM-10's collapsible consequences become expanded phases; SUM-11's detached outcomes list becomes item-inline. These are presentation replacements, not fact deletion. SUM-08's Clear adjustment is preserved as Remove, and reorder is still available when meaningful.
- [Persistent specification](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/144), implementing its cited [amount/control removal amendment](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/109#issuecomment-5837634317), owns removal of the differing recorded-buyoff-cost warning from **live** Summary and its live counts. Honor its exact filter; do not suppress other buyoff/treasury warnings, historical warning facts or legacy source amounts.

## 5. Data, payloads and rules

**No schema, query/mutation argument, result-shape or Weekly Resolution change is approved here. No Ruleset Version bump.** Consume the version current when this ships; retain every old record's recorded version. History listing/date changes belong only to Finished weeks. New presentation types/adapters are client code over existing data, not persisted fields or API additions.

### Six-section presentation contract for live and historical consumers

Use shared pure renderable data for ordered phase sections/items, check descriptions, phase changes, item-attached warnings/exceptions/outcomes, ordered adjustment effects and comparison facts. Identities are internal stable keys, never user-facing strings. The renderer receives those facts and explicit editing capabilities; it must not query live campaigns, call a resolver, or infer its mode from today's militia.

**Live adapter:** consume the current workspace source, optimistic Weekly Draft, canonical Resolution Preview and the accepted-review/pending state. Existing seams are `summary-facts.ts`, `summary-messages.ts`, `summary-view.tsx`, `summary-outcome.tsx`, `summary-adjustments.tsx`, `types.ts` and the workspace store. Derive Now from this current week's source snapshot; Rules Baseline and Final come from the same preview and must not mix revisions. Read all effects (including `effects.sabotage`) and nested context without losing information hidden by the current generic fact renderer. Incomplete preview is visibly incomplete: null/unavailable outcome is not zero, unchanged or a fabricated week N+1 result. Preserve available partial consequences, disclose unavailable comparison facts, and keep requirements/repair reachable.

Map subjects using stored IDs and known semantic subjects, including Activity choice and `special:`/reaction prefixes, Event occurrences/candidates/Roll Twice children, nested persistent decisions, Sabotage, Upkeep transfers/team decisions and carried event instances. Use plan provenance and real execution order rather than UI card order or alphabetic object traversal. Place phase totals from phase plans before Table Adjustments; do not apply adjustment deltas a second time. Retain action/event/team/settlement names and distinguish repeated same-type occurrences by recorded order/context. Avoid opaque IDs in labels and errors.

Warnings in records have code/message and optional rule source, not a subject field. Use known code/subject conventions for association; never add a backend subject to make the layout easier. A fact whose item is missing stays as a standalone row at the end of its known phase. If even the phase cannot be determined from existing facts, retain a clearly labelled unassociated-facts group within the six-section presentation rather than discarding it or inventing a target; live aggregate Warnings retains that entry too. Preserve distinct warnings sharing text. Do not use fuzzy string matching to attach a warning to the wrong person/event.

**Frozen-record adapter contract for Finished weeks:** input is only the selected immutable `CanonicalResolutionRecord`, using `source`, optional `sourceMilitiaSnapshot`, `baselinePlan`, `finalPlan`, `finalOutcome`, `adjudication`, `warnings` and `successorContext`. Use existing artifact `formatVersion` support and record-local names. Read the stored plans/outcomes, never run the current rules engine, borrow current officers/character labels or fetch today's militia to fill gaps. Missing old facts get a truthful **Not recorded**/existing unavailable explanation and remain readable; retain readable fallback for supported legacy artifact shapes. Historical rendering cannot import a live draft store or editing callbacks. The owning history spec integrates this adapter and its list/audit controls later; deliver the shared boundary and fixtures here so that integration is independent of live projections.

Both modes use the same section numbering, consequence order, check details, warning/exception/outcome positions and ordered adjustment list. Historical exceptions and reasons are quoted read-only text, with no clear/reorder/edit/Confirm control. History labels are **At confirmation** instead of Now, **Result · week N+1 began**, and **No Table Adjustments. The Final outcome equals the Rules Baseline.** Show all also includes recorded Operating from, uneventful-week carry, first-Upkeep skip and officers at confirmation; live Show all shows the corresponding available source/next-week facts. Frozen records retain historical differing-buyoff-cost warnings and source amounts even though Persistent removes that warning from the live presentation. Do not mutate or rewrite a record while reading it.

Result comparison must retain the union of facts from source, baseline and Final, including added/removed teams/events/settlements and nonnumeric values. Compare semantic values/identities, not formatted text; show additions/removals and reversals honestly. Show all preserves rank, training, treasury, notoriety, focus, settlements/reputation, team conditions/managers, roster/officers/characters, bonuses, event benefits, economy/assets/delivery, carried events, queued effects and remaining week context represented by current schemas. Old forms or unknown supported facts must remain readable through the existing general fact fallback rather than be silently dropped.

### Complete Table Adjustment and reason forms

Keep `tableAdjustmentSchema`'s entire discriminated union:

| Kind | Required fields and choices |
| --- | --- |
| `militia_value` | Stable adjustment identity; `training`, `treasuryCopper`, `notoriety` or `rank`; `add` or `set`; signed integer value; nonblank reason. Preserve negative and zero values, including structurally valid out-of-rules results. Default the existing new Militia value form to Treasury/Add. |
| `team_status` | Exact campaign team, every existing status (`active`, `disabled`, `missing`), reason. |
| `settlement_reputation` | Exact campaign settlement, every reputation from the shared domain enum, reason. |
| `event_end` | Exact applicable persistent event instance, reason; preserve duplicate event types as separate choices. |

Money displays and inputs use gp over stored integer copper. Convert exactly, including negative amounts and one-copper precision; e.g. −0.07 gp writes −7 copper. Reject malformed/unsafe/excess-precision values with a field error, never silently round or coerce blank to zero. Other militia values remain signed whole numbers. Rule deviations are advisory or use existing required Rules Exceptions; this presentation does not tighten existing schemas or turn warnings into blockers.

Save through the existing `table_adjustments` edit containing the full ordered list. Add once with a stable ID; edit preserves identity; remove affects only that ID; reorder preserves all other values/reasons. Build the operation against the latest accepted/optimistic list and retain existing revision/operation conflict behavior. Do not send a stale array captured when a form opened over another player's changes, invent a batch endpoint, or silently retry conflicting intent. On conflict reconcile, show the accepted state and keep recoverable local intent/errors; a remote edit never erases an unrelated adjustment. Cancel sends no edit and does not undo accepted remote changes.

Exception reasons use existing `rules_exception` and `clear_rules_exception` operations, preserving exception/subject/rule IDs. Clearing an exception with × revokes its permission and restores the underlying required decision; it does not save an empty strict exception. Do not edit an obsolete action-capacity exception into permission. Missing/blank adjustment reasons remain invalid **local form state**: the strict saved adjustment cannot contain an empty reason. Keep the last accepted adjustment while editing, mark the field amber with textual error and surface the local required decision; block this device's Confirm until valid Save or Cancel/removal. Never fabricate invalid saved records or automatically delete an adjustment because the reason was cleared. Unsaved local changes are not shared facts and do not block another device from confirming its accepted reviewed week. If another member confirms, retain no editable stale form against the successor; frame transition resets it by draft identity.

`react-hook-form` and `zod` validate forms with styled field errors and `noValidate`; separate missing from malformed values. Meaningful local incomplete forms, save failures and remote conflicts must remain visible and prevent accidentally confirming their old accepted values on that device. Do not replace raw typed invalid input on every subscription refresh. Successful Save/Cancel clears the relevant local-only state; identity-keyed resets handle a different draft/item. Changes accepted elsewhere continue to update preview and invalidate stale reviews through the existing store. If a target disappears, show its unavailable-target state and recovery link; preserve corrections' complete-reference repair limitations instead of promising unrelated writes can bypass orphaned references.

### Confirmation contract and shared transition

`canConfirm` remains governed by the existing persistence/workspace accepted review, never inferred solely from zero Required decisions or a visually plausible forecast. Confirm the exact reviewed draft identity/revision and source identity/revision/key, using the existing operation identity and server transaction. Pending optimistic edits are not an accepted review. New local invalid/unsaved form gating may further disable Confirm without changing backend readiness or storing local form state.

A stale/rejected Confirmation commits nothing and shows **The week could not be confirmed as reviewed** with **Review updated week**. Failed saves restore saved values and require fresh review. Review updated week requests/reuses the legitimate accepted preview through the existing store; it never confirms automatically. A new accepted server preview cannot silently authorize a retry after a rejected attempt. A source correction invalidates the review even when displayed numbers happen to be equal.

During Confirmation disable all week editing including open adjustment/reason surfaces, show **Confirming…**, preserve the reviewed content until the next draft actually arrives, and keep pending departure protection. Only one concurrent Confirmation may succeed; an edit/confirm race cannot apply both to the reviewed revision. Existing transport replay retries use the same operation identity; never add an auto-submit loop or create a new operation after uncertain success. Failure restores a usable review. On success the frame adopts the successor's Upkeep once and shows every observing device **Week N confirmed.** with the correct Finished weeks link; no skeleton flash, retained successor edit, or duplicate notice.

The persisted source, complete baseline/final plans and final outcome must equal the accepted preview; every field of next-week context is preserved. Keep immutable record creation, old draft closure and successor creation atomic. Delayed edits tied to the closed draft cannot affect the successor. Upkeep's legacy `{ dice, sides, provenance, modifiers }` and new `{ diceTotal, diceCount, sides, provenance, modifiers }` remain distinct supported forms; totals are dice only, modifiers count once, partial/wrong-count/sides inputs remain incomplete, out-of-range totals stay advisory. No eager conversion, source cleanup, schema relaxation or historical recalculation belongs here.

## 6. Validation and coverage

Preserve every existing E2E scenario with equivalent behavior. Required rewrites and retained contracts:

| Existing suite | Treatment |
| --- | --- |
| `e2e/support/summary-qa.ts` via `canonical-workspace.spec.ts` | Rewrite Summary navigation label, generic form/disclosure locators, Clear adjustment → Remove, and copper → exact gp. Retain signed add/set and noncommutative ordering, all four kinds including settlement fixture, missing-reason failure, peer updates, complete future/roster/officer facts, removal restoring original result, absence of opaque IDs and responsive geometry. |
| Workspace helpers and `complete-week.spec.ts` | Keep Required decisions, Go repair, pending/rejected save, stale review, explicit re-review, real Confirmation and reload. Earlier phase edits update Summary, live counts and comparison consistently. |
| `canonical-confirmation.spec.ts` and `tests/persistence/confirmation-contracts.ts` | Keep the entire shared backend contract, including exact source/baseline/outcome/next-context equality, idempotent replay/dropped acknowledgement, closed-draft delayed edits, unavailable-slot rejection and repair, concurrent Confirmation, external source revision/treasury changes, incomplete rejection, pending-edit barrier, final-write rollback, explicit retry and edit/confirm race. These remain required even though browser inventory rows do not map them all. |
| `canonical-persistence.spec.ts` and shared persistence contracts | Keep authenticated membership, draft/campaign isolation, semantic operations, stale writes, replay, rollback and dropped-acknowledgement coverage; do not replace these with component-only assertions. |
| `existing-militia.spec.ts`, `access.spec.ts`, `canonical-cutover.spec.ts`, relevant action/character suites | Preserve source correction, reload, outsider/organization isolation, maintenance and cross-device behavior; unrelated scenarios are not deleted because UI selectors change. |

Retain/extend `summary-view.test.tsx` cases `[rules.P85.adjustment]`, `[rules.P85.review]`, `[rules.P85.order]`, `[rules.P85.exception]`, `[rules.P85.outcomes]`, `[rules.P85.readiness]` and `[rules.F04.obsolete-exception]`; update presentation assertions while keeping semantics. Extend store/preview/record adapter tests where behavior crosses the view boundary.

Acceptance scenarios to add or make explicit:

1. All four consequence sections are ordered/expanded; phase chips and check details derive from real plans, Event includes Sabotage and same-week persistent facts once, repeated subjects remain distinct, empty/incomplete states are truthful. Every exception/acknowledgement and known/unknown warning remains visible through association/fallback. Top warnings, phase counts and live Persistent warning filter agree.
2. Reasons edit/clear/obsolete remove; missing/whitespace reason and invalid local fields stay visible with repair links, no invalid payload is sent, no accidental old-value Confirmation. All four adjustment forms and enum choices, add/set signed/zero/copper-exact values, edit/cancel/remove/reorder at both boundaries, no move controls for zero/one adjustment. Test order-sensitive results and remote list edits while a form is open.
3. Result changed-only includes baseline change reversed by an adjustment, structural additions/removals and nonnumeric changes; Final emphasis compares to baseline. Show all exposes all source/future facts with names and no opaque IDs. Missing full preview never becomes a fabricated final result.
4. Two members on independent phases observe accepted reasons/adjustments and optimistic/failed saves correctly. Edit and reorder conflicts, dropped acknowledgement, a source correction with equal numbers, remote change during review and another member confirming with this device's unfinished local form all recover without lost accepted work or stale successor edits.
5. Confirmation pending disables all editing and keeps reviewed content visible; every direct backend contract above still passes. Failed request requires explicit re-review/attempt. Successful stored baseline, outcome and successor match accepted preview exactly; every device gets one correct frame transition/notice/link.
6. Pure historical fixtures use only selected record facts, including older records missing source snapshots, legacy artifact formats, legacy dice/transfer actors/costs and newer totals. Modifying today's militia/officers/names cannot change historical output. No mutation, live query or current-rule resolution is performed. History retains the recorded buyoff warning that live Summary filters. Read-only presentation has no mutation controls.
7. Nonmembers/other organizations cannot read or mutate; spoofed draft/campaign/team/event/settlement IDs are server-rejected. All legitimate members have equal permission. Maintenance keeps data readable; write rejection uses normal save/review recovery. Structurally invalid data blocks; range/rule warnings retain existing advisory/exception behavior.
8. Keyboard/touch operation of kind cards, fields, Go links, Show all, reason clear, edit/remove/reorder, review and Confirm; accessible names identify subject and action, color is not the only signal, errors/status announce meaningfully and focus returns after removal/cancel. Validation expands inside its field without misaligning adjacent controls.

Check phone 390×844 and landscape, tablet 1180×820 with reference panel open/closed, and desktop 1440×900. Assert no horizontal document scroll, clipped chip/control text, overlapping errors, hidden Confirmation/focus behind fixed bars or mobile keyboard. Verify real content and behavior, not screenshots alone. Run `pnpm -s typecheck`, `pnpm -s lint`, relevant unit/integration tests and affected E2E through the isolated-preview harness in `e2e/README.md`; report actual results and environment limitations. This authoring task deploys nothing and makes no claim that feature tests have passed.

## 7. Routes and rollout

Destination: `/campaigns/<id>/week?phase=summary`, labelled **Review & confirm**. Shell preserves `/canonical-workspace?campaign=<id>&phase=summary` redirects and campaign/phase context. Go links target that campaign's phase through frame navigation; retain direct Summary bookmarks, reload and Back/Forward. No separate confirmation route or overlay.

Native implementation dependency: **blocked by [Implement carried Persistent events and shared support decisions](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/144)**. [Guided Militia Setup](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/138) is next in the shipping chain and must be natively blocked by this implementation issue. Finished weeks later consumes this presentation contract and ships after Characters & officers. Authoring dependencies are separate; resolving this spec task unblocks writing Finished weeks, not shipping it.

Keep the current Summary, Confirmation and every source editor reachable until this complete replacement covers their capabilities. The existing history page stays functional while the shared presentation boundary is introduced; do not remove its adapter, legacy record support or existing routes. Remove obsolete Summary component shells only after replacement coverage, not source data/parsers. Preserve interim roster/officer and correction access under their owners. No new navigation, backend migration or approved behavior from a later owner is silently pulled into this delivery.

### Published implementation handoffs

Implement after [Implement carried Persistent events and shared support decisions](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/144). The next shipping area is [Implement guided Militia Setup with browser resume](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/138). The native dependencies between implementation issues encode this shipping order; authoring tasks are already complete.

Other referenced implementation contracts: [Implement Finished weeks with immutable records and paged audit history](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/146).

## 8. Shippable when

- SUM-01–11 and every shared obligation above have implemented coverage or the cited signed-off presentation replacement. Inventory shows actual locations/tests, preserves IDs/removal history and marks this area shipped only after implementation.
- Review block and six expanded sections match approved B: accurate ordered consequences, item-local adjudication/warnings, complete editable ordered adjustments and exact Now/Rules Baseline/Final with changed-only/Show all. Removed copy stays absent; disabled reasons and repair links remain available.
- No locally invalid/unsubmitted form is mistaken for saved input. Strict mutation payloads, identity/reference validation, accepted list conflict handling, full field coverage and exact gp/copper conversions pass. Cross-device edits/reload and all existing Confirmation/persistence scenarios pass without weakened assertions.
- Live/frozen presentation separation is demonstrable with fixtures; later history can render only the selected immutable record. All historical facts and supported legacy forms remain readable; no unapproved payload/result/rules change or Ruleset Version bump occurs.
- Tablet landscape uses vertically ordered sections and four kind cards where space permits, Result columns fit with the docked panel. Below tablet width, kind cards are 2×2, headers/chips/fields wrap and Result becomes a stacked value list with Now/Rules Baseline/Final labels. At desktop 1280px+, only the frame's middle phase column scrolls, with footer below; the overall page does not scroll. Phone bars/sheets belong to frame/shell and do not cover content or focused controls.
- Loading resembles the review block/sections inside the week skeleton; failed week uses **The week could not be loaded. / Try again** with usable tabs; no militia offers **Set up militia**; unavailable/sign-in uses the shell gate. No adjustments, no consequences, incomplete preview, stale review, save failure, maintenance and pending successor all have honest usable states.
- Required typecheck/lint and meaningful unit/integration/E2E checks pass with recorded evidence and explicit limitations for any unrun environment-dependent check. Prototype branches remain unmerged.
